- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 各位︰ 「嶺南文化與世界」公開講座系列2026──藝文嶺南：工藝、詩畫與人文景觀，由香港中文大學中國文化研究所嶺南文化研究計劃與香港公共圖書館聯合主辦，兩場知識與美學兼具的專題講座將於10 月 25 日（日）及11 月 28 日（六）在香港中央圖書館演講廳舉行。 兩場專題講座聚焦嶺南在跨域交流中的文化生產與藝術創造，從清代廣州工藝實踐與嶺南羅浮人文地景兩個主題切入。一方面，探討廣東銅胎琺瑯器如何在中外貿易背景下融合西洋裝飾元素，體現廣州工匠對外來技術與審美的創新轉化；另一方面，考察蘇軾嶺南詩文對地方知識、人文景觀與文化記憶的建構作用，以及清代與之相關的《羅浮香影圖》。透過工藝、詩畫與人文景觀的視角進行觀察，本系列將展現嶺南文化在跨域和歷史互動中的創新活力。 本講座系列為香港研究資助局協作研究計劃「嶺南文化與世界」項目（2023–2026）活動，亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。 報 名： 按此 第一講 來自西洋的靈感 —— 清代廣東銅胎琺瑯的創意轉譯 講 者： 尹翠琪教授 香港中文大學藝術系副教授 日 期： 10 月 25 日（星期日） 時 間： 10:30 a.m. – 12:00 noon →→→ 講座摘要 ←←← 第二講 蘇軾與嶺南文化地景——從地方書寫到《羅浮香影圖》的跨地域傳播 講 者： 陳芳芳教授 香港浸會大學中文、歷史、宗教及哲學學部歷史系助理教授 日 期： 11 月 28 日（星期六） 時 間： 2:30 p.m. – 4:00 p.m. →→→ 講座摘要 ←←← 地 點： 香港中央圖書館地下演講廳 查 詢： 2921 0285 / 3943 7382 網 頁： 香港公共圖書館 www.hkpl.gov.hk 香港中文大學中國文化研究所 www.ics.cuhk.edu.hk **粵語主講** **請於講座舉行前15分鐘入座** **免費入場，座位有限，請報名留座** * 香港研究資助局協作研究計劃「嶺南文化與世界」項目（ 2023 –2026） Art and Literature of Lingnan: Craftsmanship, Poetic Painting, and Humanistic Landscape, Public Lecture Series on “Lingnan Culture and the World” 2026 The Public Lecture Series on “Lingnan Culture and the World” 2026, themed “Art and Literature of Lingnan: Craftsmanship, Poetic Painting, and Humanistic Landscape” and jointly organised by the Institute of Chinese Studies of the Chinese University of Hong Kong and the Hong Kong Public Libraries, features two insightful talks exploring the aesthetic side of Lingnan.

The two lectures, one focused on the craftsmanship of the region during the Qing era, and the other on the humanistic landscape of Luofu, reveal how cross-regional interactions drove cultural and artistic production in Lingnan.

From: HE Chuting
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
conniehe@link.cuhk.edu.hk

你想了解孩子對於學校或日常生活裡的“領導”的看法嗎？想知道孩子對於“當領導”的意願嗎？不要錯過這次有趣又有意義的研究機會。簡單進行線上研究，還有報酬可領喔~~
招募對象
：
在香港就讀小1到小6的小學生以及其父親或母親
目前各個組別依舊在積極招募，尤其小2、小5、小6組別以及各個組別的女孩子組依舊席位多多！誠摯邀請合乎要求的小朋友同家長參與~~如果你們身邊有合乎要求的小朋友和家長，也懇請幫我們多多宣傳~~
研究項目：
小學生、家長及老師的領導認知與刻板印象
研究內容（全程以中文進行）：
1.孩子：1對1線上訪談（需錄音），約需1小時。
2.家長：填寫1份網上問卷，約需1小時。
報酬：
家長和孩子完成各自的研究項目後，可獲得共100港幣報酬。
參與條件：
1.兒童參加者為在港就讀小1到小6的小學生，家長參加者為該兒童的父親或母親。
2.兒童能講流利廣東話或普通話，家長能閱讀和書寫中文。
3.兒童可使用有互聯網、視頻和音頻功能的電腦或平板參與研究。
4.兒童沒有主要的身體障礙（如：視障、四肢不健全）和未被診斷有任何有關精神健康或主要的發展障礙的狀況（如：自閉症、過度活躍）。
5.請留意參加者需在此前沒有參與過本研究的“預實驗”或“教師部分”（如不清楚是否參與過也可先留下聯繫方式，稍後我們的研究人員將與您聯繫進行確認）。
如對本實驗感興趣，請通過以下鏈接報名
，我們的研究人員將盡快聯繫您：https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_6KzWB6HhTtOhwou
參與純屬自願性質，所收集的資料只作研究用途及保密處理。如有任何疑問，請聯繫何小姐（conniehe@link.cuhk.edu.hk)。

From: Queenie Chow

誠邀閣下與子女參與一項關於華語兒童中英數能力的跨學科大型研究，詳情如下：
對象：
幼稚園高班至六年級單生兒和雙胞胎學生（包括同卵雙生和異卵雙生）
學童家長
學童需以廣東話為母語，並在香港居住 2.5 年以上
目的：
建立學童在中、英文讀寫和數學能力發展的多模態模型，以及設計能夠全面反映兒童在這三方面表現的網上測試工具
研究內容：
第一部分
學童：中英文和數學能力的測試
，分成網上測試和面對面測試兩部分。網上測試分為六個區域，各需時約40分鐘。網上測試毋須一次完成，參加者可自行安排時間分段執行，在四星期內完成所有項目即可。
面對面測試在網上測試完成後另約時間進行，約需45分鐘
家長：
在網上測試平台接受
約
15
分鐘的語文及數學測試
，及填寫關於學童學習情況與家庭語言環境的
問卷
*
現在報名的幼稚園高班至六年級學童只需完成今年一次測試
第二部分（可選擇是否參與）
學童：腦電圖測試（EEG），約2小時
報酬：今年測試完結後將收到：
(1) 測試結果的個人報告；(2) 港幣200元超級市場現金券；(3) 小禮物，
參與腦電圖 (EEG) 部份的學生另有250元超級市場現金券
研究詳情及報名請見以下網頁：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4OWk4Rmnmb0M20e
如對是項研究有任何疑問或查詢，歡迎聯絡本項目的首席研究員Urs Maurer教授（電郵: umaurer@cuhk.edu.hk）或研究小組（電話：3943-4379；電郵：
lifespandevlab.cuhk@gmail.com
）。
We are recruiting for a multi-disciplinary study about the Chinese, English, and Mathematical abilities among Chinese-speaking children in Hong Kong. Details are as below:
Target participants:
Singletons and twins (both identical and fraternal) from K3 to P6 in the 2025/26 school year
Students’ parents
The child participant must be a native Cantonese speaker and have lived in Hong Kong for more than 2.5 years.
Content:
Part 1
Students
: A series of assessments on Chinese, English, and mathematics on the project’s online testing platform. The tasks are divided into six portions; each takes about 40 minutes to finish. Online testing can be completed at your own pace, as long as all tasks are completed within 4 weeks.
A follow-up face-to-face session (45 minutes) will be arranged upon completion of the online testing.
Parents
: Short online testing on language and mathematics abilities (15 minutes), as well as a set of questionnaires on children’s learning and home language environment
*For current registration
s, students from K3 to P6 only need to complete the test once this year.
Part 2 (optional)

有興趣的同學請提供每週至少兩個時間段，以便安排。

From: Esther Qiu

Research Study: Daily Experiences with Companion Animals and Well-being
Do you have a dog or cat?
About the Study
We invite you to participate in a research study aimed at exploring people’s daily experiences with their companion animals and how they may be associated with their well-being.
Who Can Participate?
You are eligible to participate if you:
Are aged 18–60 years old;
Currently own a dog(s) or cat(s);
Reside in the Greater China region; and
Are able to complete online surveys in Chinese independently.
What Will Participation Involve?
Complete a baseline survey (5 minutes) and a short online survey (5 minutes)
every evening for 5 consecutive days.
Token of Appreciation
Participants who
complete the 5-day study
have the option to receive
HKD $180
.
Interested in participating?
Please start HERE:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_3sEX1mk9dpg51lk
研究招募：與伴侶動物的日常及身心健康
你有養狗狗或貓貓嗎？
關於研究
我們誠邀您參加一項研究，探討人們與伴侶動物的日常相處經驗，以及這些經驗可能如何與身心健康有關。
參加資格
如果你符合以下條件，即可參加本研究：
年齡介乎 18–60 歲；
現時有飼養狗狗或貓貓；
現時居住於大中華地區；以及
能夠獨立完成中文網上問卷。
參加流程
你需要完成一份基線問卷（約5分鐘），並於
連續5日
每晚完成一份簡短網上問卷（約5分鐘）。
參與謝禮
完成
整個5日
研究的參加者，可選擇獲得
港幣 $180
作為答謝。
有興趣參加？

10日

title: Join CUHK’s Time-Restricted Eating & Sleep Study! 中大「限時進食 改善睡眠」減重研究誠招參加者
bodyText:

Announcements
Join CUHK’s Time-Restricted Eating & Sleep Study! 中大「限時進食 改善睡眠」減重研究誠招參加者 - Department of Sports Science and Physical Education
From: DAI, Zihan
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
zihandai@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The CUHK Department of Sports Science and Physical Education is recruiting adults struggling with excess weight and insomnia for a 12-week study exploring how Time-Restricted Eating (TRE) combined with Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) affects weight management and sleep quality.
Eligibility Requirements
Chinese adults, aged 18 or above.
Overweight or obese (BMI ≥ 23 kg/m²) with a stable weight over the past 3 months.
Current daily eating window is 10 hours or more.
Suffering from insomnia for at least 3 months (e.g., difficulty falling or staying asleep, impacting daily life).
Not Eligible If You Are
Diagnosed with severe cardiovascular disease or diabetes.
Taking weight-loss medications (e.g., GLP-1) within the past 3 months.
Currently receiving or have previously received psychological therapy for insomnia (including CBT-I).
A night-shift worker or a smoker.
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant.
Study Details & Participant Tasks
Intervention:
12-week period where participants are randomly assigned to one of two groups:
TRE Group:
8-hour eating window and 16-hour fasting daily.
TRE + CBT-I Group:
TRE protocol plus 6 bi-weekly in-person sessions at CUHK.
Requirements:
Maintain daily logs of eating times; Complete sleep, diet, and physical activity. Attend follow-up assessments at baseline, Week 12, and Week 24.
Benefits:
Free comprehensive health and sleep assessments, and a personalized health evaluation report upon completion.
Registration
The study begins in September 2026. Quotas are limited.

Sign up here:
https://forms.gle/4sMg3UD92vgWhU6F8
If you are eligible based on initial assessment, our research team will contact you shortly. Thank you!
香港中文大學正在籌備一項限時進食及睡眠改善減重研究
內容如下:
研究參加者招募：限時進食及睡眠改善減重研究
香港中文大學體育運動科學系現正招募 超重或肥胖並受失眠困擾的成年人，參與一項研究，探討 失眠認知行為治療（CBTI）結合限時進食（Time-Restricted Eating） 對體重控制及睡眠質素的效果。
基本參加資格：
• 華裔人士,18歲或以上
• 超重或肥胖（BMI ≥ 23 kg/m²）
• 體重於過去3個月保持穩定
• 平日進食時段達10小時或以上
• 患有持續3個月或以上的失眠問題（包括難以入睡、容易醒來或過早醒來等, 睡眠問題影響日常生活 ）
不適合參加人士：
• 患有嚴重心血管疾病或糖尿病
• 過去3個月曾使用減重藥物（如GLP-1類藥物）
• 正接受失眠心理治療或曾接受失眠認知行為治療治療
• 夜班工作人士 , 吸煙人士
• 懷孕、哺乳或計劃懷孕人士
研究內容：
•⁠  ⁠免費健康及睡眠評估
• 為期12星期的介入
隨機分配至：
•⁠  ⁠限時進食組（每日8小時進食、16小時禁食）
•⁠  ⁠限時進食＋每2星期一堂失眠認知行為治療組（CBTI）：除限時進食外，需於指定時間前往香港中文大學上課（共 6 堂）
• 完成後可獲個人健康評估報告
研究期間需配合：
• 每日記錄進食時間
• 完成睡眠、飲食及身體活動記錄
• 參與基線、12星期及24星期的跟進評估
研究預計於2026年9月開始，名額有限。
報名連結：https://forms.gle/4sMg3UD92vgWhU6F8

[Co-op@CUHK - AI Interview Free Trials & Application for 6th Cohort!]
As AI continues to transform recruitment processes, interview preparation has become more important than ever. Many employers now use AI-powered tools to assess candidates' communication skills, professionalism, and overall suitability for a role. Our AI Mock Interview platform helps students stay ahead by offering realistic interview practice, instant AI-generated feedback, and personalised insights to help identify strengths, address areas for improvement, and build confidence for future interviews.
The Co-operative Education Programme is pleased to offer a
FREE AI Mock Interview Trial
for CUHK undergraduate students until
30 September 2026 (Wednesday)
. Take advantage of this opportunity to sharpen your interview skills and enhance your readiness for future internship and career opportunities!
Register Now for Your Free AI Mock Interview Trial
! Quotas are limited and will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.
What can you enjoy from the AI Mock Interview Free Trial?
One AI Mock Interview practice session
Realistic interview practice to strengthen your interview skills and confidence
Your interview performance video with AI-powered analysis
Personalised AI interview report highlighting your strengths and areas for improvement
Meanwhile, applications for the
6th Cohort of the Co-operative Education Programme
are now open. Year 2 or above undergraduate students from all disciplines, including both local and non-local students, are welcome to apply. The next round of interviews will be held in
late September
. To be considered in this round, we encourage you to submit your application as early as possible.
The Co-operative Education Programme
offers a unique opportunity for students to integrate academic learning with meaningful workplace experience. Through the programme, students can develop professional competencies, gain valuable industry exposure, expand their professional networks, and enhance their employability upon graduation.
Why join the Co-operative Education Programme?
Real-World Experience
: Gain hands-on experience in your field of study and make valuable connections.
Career Development
: Strengthen your resume and boost your employability with practical skills.
Networking Opportunities
: Meet industry professionals and fellow students who share your ambitions.
Apply now
and take the first step towards gaining valuable professional experience while preparing for a successful future career!
Stay connected with us on
LinkedIn
and
IG
for the latest updates. For any questions, please reach out to our team at
coop@cuhk.edu.hk
.

bodyText:

[Enroll Now !] UGED 2327 - "The Book of Changes" and Wisdom of Life [立即報名 !]UGED 2327 - 《易經》與人生智慧 - Department of Cultural and Religious Studies
From: Joanne Lau
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
joannelauly@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
※ 在選課時，不期望學生對
《易經》
或相關文本已有充分的閱讀經驗。
你有無諗過我地可以用
《易經》
解構尼個世界
下個
星期二
2:30pm
就係時候去
LDS214
大家一齊去探索一下！
《易經》博大精深，對中國的宗教、哲學、政治及醫學影響深遠，長期被譽為「群經之首」。《易經》以符號系統揭示宇宙變化的規律，並指引人們如何順應天道而生活，從而培養德行、增強能力、領悟智慧。《易經》遠非「占筮之書」所能涵蓋，堪稱「智慧寶典」，其智慧雖古老，用於應對當今變幻莫測之世，卻往往依然行之有效。本課程以《易經》為研讀對象，闡述其成書的歷史及詮釋方法，並選取其重要篇章及卦爻辭，分析當中的主題及灼見，讓學生能開濶視野，以新的角度觀察世界，進而啟發人生智慧。

課程名稱：
UGED 2327 - 《易經》與人生智慧

時間：
02:30PM - 04:15PM （二）

課室：
LDS_214
※
When selecting this course, students are not required to have extensive reading experience with the I Ching* or related texts.
Have you ever considered using the I Ching to deconstruct our world?
Join us next Tuesday at 2:30 pm in LDS214 for an engaging exploration!
"The Book of Changes" (Yijing) is a highly venerated and influential classic that has made far-reaching impacts on the Chinese religion, philosophy, politics and medicine. It has a far greater significance for the Chinese culture as a book of wisdom than a divination manual, by offering a wealth of knowledge and insights about the cosmos, nature, and life. It shows us the ways to cultivate virtue, enhance ability and perceive wisdom by living our lives and making judgments in harmony with the changing forces of the universe. The store of ancient wisdom accumulated in this classic is often still relevant to our contemporary world that is in constant and rapid technological, social and political changes. Through guided reading of the key notions and themes encapsulated in some selected hexagrams, students may draw from the wellspring of profound wisdom in the "The Book of Changes" to stimulate their reflection on the approach of life, the way of looking at the world, and the recurring issues facing humanity.

Course Title:
UGED 2327 - "The Book of Changes" and Wisdom of Life

Time:
02:30PM - 04:15PM (Tue)

Classroom:
LDS_214

From: Diversity and Inclusion Office

dio@cuhk.edu.hk

各位中大同事及同學：
中大多元共融節 2026/27
《不同凡響》共融音樂會
一個舞台，不同才能的音樂家，共同奏響超乎想像的無限可能！我們深信「誰都可發光」—— 只要找對地方，自然不同凡響。
多元共融事務處主辦的多元共融節 2026/27，將以
《不同凡響》共融音樂會
隆重揭幕。演出陣容包括：
•
特別嘉賓：
實力派唱作歌手
陳蕾
及二胡演奏家兼電影配樂家
朱芸編

香港展能藝術會藝術家：丁怡杰、莫梓源及鄧卓謙

一眾
中大學生演奏家
從古典樂章到流行旋律，表演者將在合作與交流中展現多元共融精神，演繹「和而不同」的美好，讓觀眾感受音樂連結人心的力量。

時間： 晚上7時
地點： 香港中文大學邵逸夫堂
歡迎所有中大教職員及學生參加。請於
2026年9月27日（星期日）或之前
透過以下連結報名：
登記
*活動將以廣東話輔以英語進行。
** 座位有限，不設劃位，先到先得。
香港中文大學
多元共融事務處
電話：3943 0382
電郵：
dio@cuhk.edu.hk
Dear CUHK colleagues and students,
CUHK Diversity and Inclusion Festival 2026/27
The Inclusive Concert: Beauty of Our Differences
On one stage, diverse music talents come together to create infinite possibilities beyond imagination! We firmly believe that "everyone has the power to shine" — when you find the right stage, you will strike a chord beyond limits.
The Diversity and Inclusion Office will present
“The Inclusive Concert: Beauty of Our Differences”
as the opening event for the CUHK Diversity and Inclusion Festival 2026/27.  The lineup includes:
•
Special Guests:
Renowned singer-songwriter
Panther Chan
and award-winning erhuist and film composer
Chu Wan Pin
•
Featured Artists
from the
Arts with the Disabled Association Hong Kong: Ding Yijie, Malcolm Mok and Anson Tang
•
CUHK Headliners:
Your fellow
CUHK student
performers!
From classical masterpieces to contemporary favourites, performers will demonstrate the spirit of diversity and inclusion through collaboration and exchange. Embracing the concept of “harmony in diversity”, the concert celebrates the beauty of differences while allowing the audience to experience the power of human connection through music performance.
Date: 6 October 2026 (Tuesday)
Time: 7:00 pm
Venue: Sir Run Run Shaw Hall, CUHK
All CUHK staff and students are welcome to attend. Please register via the link below
on or before 27 September 2026 (Sunday)
:

**Limited seating is available on a first-come, first-served basis. No seat reservation is available.

bodyText:

Announcements
CFA Scholarships 2026-27  - Department of Finance
From: Quantitative Finance Programme
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
qfin@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear Student,
CFA Institute Student Scholarships for the 2027 Level I Exam are now open for application. There will only be one round of CFA scholarship application this year, with 12 scholarships available for those intending to take the exam. Based on past years, the scholarship is highly competitive — roughly 10 applicants for every award — and selection will be based on your academic performance and finance industry exposure. If you plan to apply for the scholarship, please
do not
register for the exam at this time. Regardless of whether you are selected for the award, CFA Institute will send you the exam registration link once you have applied for the scholarship.
Important information:
Application Period:
Sep 9 – Sep 30, 2026 (HKT 23:59)
Fill out the CUHK online webform by visiting
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741287
Apply for the CFA Institute Student Scholarship through the online platform. To access the platform, you will need to set up an account and log in at
https://www.cfainstitute.org/programs/cfa-program/scholarships/student
Requirement:
Before submitting your application, it is mandatory to complete the video series on the Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct (Standard I to Standard VII). You can access the series at
https://www.cfainstitute.org/standards/professionals/code-ethics-standards
. After completing the quiz, your results will be emailed to you. You must submit certificates for all quiz results as part of your application through the CUHK online webform.
Please combine your (1) CV, (2) transcript, and (3) all quiz result certificates into a
single PDF file
.
Please note that late or incomplete applications will not be considered due to limited availability. Results will be released on your CFA scholarship account no later than the end of October 10.
Best regards,
Edwin Mok, CFA
Associate Director, MSc Programme in Finance

title: Participate in this study and earn 300 HKD! :) English learning from computer-mediated English reading
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/11
»
Announcements
Participate in this study and earn 300 HKD! :) English learning from computer-mediated English reading  - Department of English
From: Jookyoung Jung
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
jookyoungjung@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Participate in this study and earn 300 HKD! :)
English learning from computer-mediated English reading
Hello! I am Jookyoung Jung, Associate Professor at the Department of English. I'd like to invite you to a study that examines the relationship between computer-mediated English reading and English learning.
If you decide to participate, I will ask you to take part in three experimental sessions.
In Session 1, we will ask you to complete a brief questionnaire about yourself. Next, you will take English proficiency tests that measure your grammar and vocabulary.
In Session 2, you will read English texts while your eye movements are recorded using an eye-tracker.
In Session 3, you will take a series of memory tasks.
In return for your participation, I am able to offer you 300 HKD at the end of the 3rd session.
If you meet the criteria below, please join our study!
Your age is 18 years or older.
Chinese is your first language, and English is your second language.
Your English score (no lower, no higher!!): DSE English: 4-5; IELTS: 5.5-6.5; TOEFL iBT: 75-95; Cambridge English Scale: 160-180
If you want to participate in this study, please complete this online survey so that we can contact you and schedule your sessions.
Link:
https://forms.gle/9NyVzTHPBvW7wgHz6
If you have any queries about the study, please feel free to contact our team at tobiiproject2021@gmail.com. I would be very grateful if you would agree to take part! :-)
Jookyoung Jung
Associate Professor, Department of English
Chinese University of Hong Kong

We are looking for 1) Medicine (MBChB / MBChB(GPS) / MBBS) student, 2) Nursing & Healthcare-related subject student, 3) Science & Engineering student for joining our Eye Learn I.CARE 2026/27 Joint School Eye Care Ambassador Training
programme!
Training Session(s): to be arranged during the Sundays of Sept 2026 +/- Oct 2026
Membership Period: Sept 2026 to Sept 2027
**Students should be able to participate in at least 16 days of research clinic (Sunday full day or occasionally Saturday half day/weekday night) during the membership period.
Major duties:
Conducting eye examinations
Operating eye investigation machines
Assisting doctor consultation
Delivering eye health education
Organizing outreach & screening activities
Come & help us if you are KEEN to...
Learn and operate different eye investigation/machines
Meet people with different backgrounds
Participate in outreach activities of our ongoing/future eye research projects
Have the chance to attach ophthalmologists during consultation with patients
Conduct research
*  Zoom briefing will be conducted in September-October, and selected students will be informed in September-October.
Please fill in the link below to register now!

https://tinyurl.com/ELIC20262027
Please also follow us on Instagram!

title: Continuing Our Journey Chapter 3 of The Nethersole School of Nursing 35th Anniversary Commemorative Book Is Now Available!
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/11
»
Newsletters
Continuing Our Journey Chapter 3 of The Nethersole School of Nursing 35th Anniversary Commemorative Book Is Now Available!  - The Nethersole School of Nursing
From: Corinna Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
corinnawong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
[Continuing Our Journey Chapter 3 of The Nethersole School of Nursing 35th Anniversary Commemorative Book Is Here!]

Chapter 3 highlights the School’s research breakthroughs and developments in recent years:

Global Engagement
| Hosting international conferences and publishing high-impact research in top-tier journals

Proven Excellence
| Achieving outstanding results in global subject rankings, research performance indicators and competitive funding

Translational Impact
| Harnessing AI and other emerging technologies, along with innovative approaches, to advance clinical practices and social ventures
Looking ahead, CU Nursing remains committed to driving impactful, international and interdisciplinary research. We will continue to pioneer technology-driven innovative holistic care models, creating meaningful impacts in Hong Kong and beyond!
View this chapter online now:
https://www.nur.cuhk.edu.hk/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Ch-3_EN_CU-Nursing-35th-Anniversary-Book.pdf
All School publications are accessible at:
https://www.nur.cuhk.edu.hk/news-events/school-publications/
【延續非凡旅程 那打素護理學院三十五周年紀念特刊：第三章正式出版！】

第三章聚焦學院近年在科研創新的突破與發展路向，重點內容包括：

連繫全球
｜主辦國際學術會議，並於頂尖期刊發表優質研究成果

實力見證
｜於世界學科排名、研究指標及研究撥款等方面屢創佳績

成果轉化
｜結合人工智能等先進科技與創新理念，推展臨床實踐與社創項目
展望未來，學院將繼續推動具影響力的國際跨學科研究，引領以科技驅動的創新全人護理服務模式，為香港以至全球社會帶來更深遠的正面影響！
立即閱讀第三章：
https://www.nur.cuhk.edu.hk/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Ch-3_TC_CU-Nursing-35th-Anniversary-Book.pdf
按此閱覽所有學院刊物：
https://www.nur.cuhk.edu.hk/news-events-hk/school-publications-hk

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

From: 香港中文大學普通話教育研究及發展中心
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
pth@fed.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
推廣普通話計劃：普通話語匯通 2026/27
本計劃由語文教育及研究常務委員會（語常會）支持、語文基金撥款

面向本港小四至小六學生，免費參加。
旨在強化並深化學生對普通話語匯的認識，幫助學生把握語匯的語義，感悟其背後的文化底蘊。在創設的情境中，提高學生運用普通話語匯水平，進行有效的口語交際。
2026/27
學年的活動加入全新內容。大部分活動將於香港中文大學校園舉行。
每月設不同活動，包括：講座、親子工作坊、自學活動、參訪活動、情境對話等。
最新活動：
語匯大講堂（一）構詞

語匯偵探 1 俗語
日期︰2026年12月18日至31日期間
自學活動，同學將收到自學材料，於舉行期間交回線上工作紙
詳情：
https://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/~pth/pth_event.php
網上報名表格：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13735691

各位同學與教職員：
由學生事務處主辦的年度校園盛事—【藝墟 Art Fair 2026】即將隆重登場！
一連三天的藝墟將於百萬大道舉行，為各學生學會及大學部門提供展現活力與創意的平台。現場設有多個特色宣傳及迎新攤位，更有精彩的舞台表演，讓大家一同感受中大多元的社團文化！

日期： 2026年9月16日 至 9月18日（星期三至五）
地點： 中文大學百萬大道
對象： 全體中大學生及教職員
歡迎大家到場支持，一齊體驗豐富的校園生活！
想了解更多最新節目詳情及動態，歡迎追蹤我們的 Instagram 專頁：@cuhk_osa_seds

Dear students and staff,
The Office of Student Affairs is excited to announce the upcoming Art Fair 2026!
Held over three days at The University Mall, the Art Fair serves as a dynamic platform for student societies and university departments to promote their activities and welcome new students. Join us to experience the unique and vibrant campus society culture at CUHK through interactive booths and live stage performances!
【Event Details】
Date: 16–18 September 2026 (Wed – Fri)
Venue: The University Mall, CUHK
Target: All CUHK Students & Staff
We warmly welcome everyone to join!

Snacks, drinks and creativity at the ELTU’s Creative Writing Nights – Travel, Food, & Ecoliterature!  - English Language Teaching Unit
From: Henry WAN
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
eltucreativewriting@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear staff and students,
Looking to meet like-minded friends, grow your writing skills and explore new genres? We’re excited to invite you to
two upcoming creative writing nights
that will inspire your storytelling and connect you with fellow creatives.
Creative Writing Night 1: Places and Plates – Travel & Food Writing for the Page & Screen
Are you a traveler with a story to tell? Or a foodie dreaming of turning your culinary adventures into captivating tales?
Join us to explore the art of travel and food storytelling — from vivid written narratives to screen-ready scripts.
Come along and:
Connect with fellow storytellers
Learn the foundational principles of travel & food writing and
Discover how to adapt your writing for short form video
Snacks and drinks provided!
Date:
Tuesday, September 29th
Time:
6:30 P.M – 8:00 P.M
Location:
YIA608
Facilitator:
Ms Jenna Lee
Register
here
.
Creative Writing Night 2: Writing the Environment – Understanding Ecoliterature and How to Write It
How can fiction help us make sense of our changing planet?
From apocalyptic futures to dystopian realism, eco-literature explores the connections between humans and the environment. Join ELTU's Dr Benjamin Driscoll and fellow student writers for this eco-literature themed writing night where you’ll:
Learn what ecoliterature is and why it matters
Explore how writers creatively respond to environmental issues
Try your hand at writing your own eco-inspired piece
Snacks and drinks provided!
Date:
6:30 P.M – 8:00 P.M, Thursday, October 8th, 2026
Location:
YIA 608
Facilitator:
Dr Benjamin Driscol
Register
here
.
We hope to see you there!
Warm regards,
ELTU Creative Writing Team

普通話水平測試攻略課程
現正招生！
在線教學模式授課（Zoom應用程式）
本課程通過講解及練習，讓學員細緻了解測試標準與要求，了解考生普遍存在的問題，發現自己現有的普通話語音及表達問題，掌握正確的備考方法。在10堂課（30課時）中，講解測試要求，提醒常見錯誤，介紹備考攻略，分享考試及複習經驗。安排針對性練習，在經驗導師指導下，讓學員把握測試標準，發現自身存在的問題，學習改進方法，進而提高普通話水平。

逢星期六（共9堂），上午9:30-12:30

）（持續進修基金課程編號：38C155714
）
中文大學校園面授
本證書課程以參加國家語委普通話水平測試（PSC）為導向，旨在提高學員普通話應用水平，具體表現為：提高學員普通話朗讀能力，掌握普通話水平測試常用詞匯，掌握朗讀規定篇目的方法，讀準字音，讀通作品。同時，提高學員使用普通話所達到的流利程度和規範程度，掌握普通話水平測試應試的技巧，做好測試前的準備；並幫助參加過測試的應試人進一步提升等級，説話時，逐步做到語音標準，語調自然，表達流暢。本證書課程不是零起點課程，學員須具有基礎普通話能力。

2026

月）

Recruitment Flyer
Project Title
A cross-cultural perspective on the association between anxiety and independent life skills
What is the study about?
In this study, we are interested in exploring whether and the extent to which independent life skills are associated with problematic behaviours (e.g., alcohol consumption) and mental health challenges (e.g., anxiety)
Who can take part?
You can take part if you are aged 18-25 and an undergraduate student at CUHK and can complete an online English survey independently.
What do we have to do?
You will complete an online English survey include questions about demographic information, educational performance, independent life skills, and mental health. The survey should take approximately 20 minutes.
What will participants receive?
As a token of appreciation for your time, participants will have the opportunity to enter a
PRIZE DRAW
to win a $100 HKD gift card.
One prize will be available for approximately every 10 participants
. If you wish to enter the draw, you will be asked to provide an email address at the end of the survey
Interested?
Please read more about the study and provide your consent here:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_7P5Kp8XG88074vY

Announcements
Paid EEG Experiment: 1.5h for 150 HKD (Language Cognition) Paid EEG Experiment: 1.5h for 150 HKD (Language Cognition) - Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages
From: Yiting WANG
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
yitingwang@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
您好！
我们诚挚地邀请您参加一项关于语言认知的脑电（EEG）实验。任务很简单：
来实验室看一些视频
。我们会记录你的脑电波，看看母语阅读时大脑有多忙碌！
本实验室使用临床级安全的脑电图系统，收集人自身产生的微弱生物电并绘制成波形图，不会对人体产生伤害。有任何安全顾虑都可以和研究人员联系了解：Miss WANG, yitingwang@cuhk.edu.hk
实验时长
：约1.5小时
实验内容：
1）佩戴脑电设备，参加互动实验，观看一些视频并用键盘按键做出反应；2）填写一些问卷。
实验地点：
中文大学梁銶琚楼G层（语言学系）G34实验室。
实验结束后，会通过转数快支付
150港元
被试费用。
参与者需要符合以下要求
：
1.
18-30
岁
，来自中国大陆，母语为汉语普通话；
2. 视力（矫正后）正常，无干涩等眼部不适；
3. 听力正常；
4. 无脑损伤、癫痫等神经类疾病，无头皮外伤或感染；
5. 无身体残疾；
6. 近2个月内无染发，实验当天不化妆，实验当天在家自行洗头；
7. 可以接受在头发头皮上涂抹特制的导电膏体（实验室配备专门的洗头房，供您实验结束之后洗净吹干）；
8. 非心理学、语言学专业；
9. 右利手（写字、用筷子等习惯使用右手）；

各位同學：
「鑑古知今・守護未來」香港歷史博物館導賞團
想了解香港與國家之間血脈相連的歷史淵源？香港歷史博物館匯聚豐富的珍貴文物與歷史照片，帶你穿梭時空，從多角度認識香港的發展歷程。活動將安排博物館專業導賞，由資深講解員帶領大家深入展廳，細味每件展品背後的故事，感受香港與祖國同根同源、命運與共的深厚連結。
此外，行程更會參觀國家安全展覽廳，同樣設有專人導賞，讓同學深入了解國家安全與香港繁榮穩定的密切關係，拓闊視野，增強國民身份認同。名額有限，萬勿錯過！立即追蹤我們IG

Dear students,
Reflecting on History, Safeguarding the Future – Guided Tour of Hong Kong Museum of History
Curious about the historical ties between Hong Kong and the nation? The Hong Kong Museum of History houses a rich collection of invaluable artefacts and historical photographs, taking you on a journey through time to explore Hong Kong's development from multiple perspectives. A guided tour led by professional docents will be arranged, allowing participants to delve into the stories behind each exhibit and appreciate the deep, enduring bond between Hong Kong and the motherland.
In addition, the itinerary includes a visit to the National Security Exhibition Gallery, also with a dedicated guided tour, to help students understand the close relationship between national security and Hong Kong's prosperity and stability — broadening their horizons and strengthening their sense of national identity. Places are limited — don't miss this opportunity! Follow us on Instagram

bodyText:

給故事一對 AI 的翅膀 ── AI編劇與影片創作工作坊 | Giving Wings to Stories ── AI Screenwriting & Video Creation Workshop   - ILC
From: ILC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ilc-counsel@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
給故事一對
AI 的翅膀 ──
AI編劇與影片創作工作坊
文字變畫面  故事變短片

工作坊內容
AI 時代，盡情釋放說故事的力量，由文字到變影片，擴闊創作的可能性
當 AI 大幅降低了故事及影片創作的技術門檻，作品的核心價值終將回歸作者風格與故事內容
敘事框架與靈感
：從個人日常經驗，轉化成具情感價值的故事與 Logline
靈魂
Prompt秘技
：由自然語言到Prompt的結構化設計(視覺風格 × 鏡頭運動 × 氛圍控制)
跨媒介工具實作
：動手操作 Suno(音樂生成)與 Seedance(影片生成)等工具，完成屬於你的 AI 作品

工作坊目標
參加者將會在四堂課之內，由概念到生成，完成一條以故事為主導的AI短片

Giving Wings to Stories
--- AI Screenwriting & Video Creation Workshop
From Words to Visuals | Turn Stories into Short Films

Workshop Overview
Unleash the power of storytelling in the AI era! Expand your creative possibilities from text to video. As AI significantly lowers the technical barriers to story and video creation, the core value of any artwork ultimately returns to the creator's personal style and narrative content.
Narrative Framework & Inspiration: Transform personal everyday experiences into emotionally resonant stories and loglines.
Mastering Prompts: Structured prompt design from natural language (Visual Style × Camera Movement × Atmosphere Control).
Cross-Media AI Tools: Hands-on experience with tools like Suno (Music Generation) and Seedance (Video Generation) to complete your unique AI artwork.

Participants will create a story-driven AI short film from concept to final video generation within 4 sessions.

bodyText:

Announcements
[$67/Hour] Recruiting Student Helper to support experiments with children [時薪$67] 招募學生助理協助兒童相關實驗 - Brain and Mind Institute
From: LEUNG Mei Yee
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The Brain and Mind Institute is recruiting student helpers to support two research projects, (a) project focuses on grandparent-grandchild interaction and hearing loss, (b) project focuses on the interaction between neurotypical children and children with Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD). The study utilizes Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy (fNIRS) and behavioral assessments to quantify these connections. Successful candidates will report for duties at Rm 406A, Wong Foo Yuan Building or 4/F of Hui Yeung Shing Building.
Hourly Rate:
$67/Hour
Duties:
Assisting with the setup, data collection, and administration of fNIRS & behavioral experiments.
Interacting closely with young children and older adults, to provide clear instructions and support during different experiment sessions.
Requirements:
Should be able to commit around 8 hours per week. Flexible weekday hours are available, but working on some weekends (Saturdays and/or Sundays) is a must.
Fluency in Cantonese is required. Possessing good communication skills, with the ability to speak loudly and clearly to ensure participants (especially older adults) understand experimental procedures.
Preferred Qualifications:
Undergraduate students (Year 2 or above) with a background in Psychology, Neuroscience, Linguistics, or other related disciplines. Interdisciplinary is also welcome.
Previous experience with fNIRS or Electroencephalogram (EEG), and working with older adults or children are significant advantages.
Candidates who are available to start immediately are preferred.
If you are interested, please fill in the form below via the following link:
https://forms.gle/eoQ4H2oetRPNkQKv5
For any inquiries, please contact May Leung (email: meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk; tel: 95867123) for more information.
大腦與認知研究所（The Brain and Mind Institute，BMI）現正招聘學生助理，以協助兩項實驗室內的學術研究項目：（一） 探討祖孫互動與聽力損失的項目；（二） 探討典型發展兒童與自閉症譜系障礙（ASD）兒童之間互動的項目。本研究採用功能性近紅外光譜成像技術 （fNIRS） 及其他行為評估，旨在量化實驗參加者互動與大腦活動的聯繫。獲聘者將會在王福元樓 406A 室或許讓城樓4樓值勤。
時薪：
$67/每小時
工作職責：
協助 fNIRS 及行為實驗的初始設置、數據收集與整理工作。
與兒童及長者密切溝通，在各實驗階段提供清晰的指令與實時支援。
申請要求：
工作時間每週需投入約 8 小時。平日工作時間可靈活安排，但必須能在部分週末（星期六及/或星期日）當值。
粵語流利。具備良好的溝通技巧。説話清晰、響亮，以確保被試（尤其長者）可充分理解實驗流程。
優先考慮條件：
心理學、神經科學、語言學或相關學科之本科生（Year 2或以上）；亦歡迎具備跨學科背景之同學申請。
具備 fNIRS 或 EEG（腦電圖）的相關經驗，以及與長者或兒童溝通合作的經驗者將獲優先考慮。
可立刻值勤者優先。
有意申請者，請點擊以下連結填寫網上申請表格：
https://forms.gle/eoQ4H2oetRPNkQKv5
如需任何查詢，歡迎與May Leung進行聯絡（email: meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk; tel: 95867123）。

The Brain and Mind Institute is recruiting student helpers to support two research projects, (a) project focuses on grandparent-grandchild interaction and hearing loss, (b) project focuses on the interaction between neurotypical children and children with Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD). The study utilizes Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy (fNIRS) and behavioral assessments to quantify these connections. Successful candidates will report for duties at Rm 406A, Wong Foo Yuan Building or 4/F of Hui Yeung Shing Building.
Hourly Rate:
$67/Hour
Duties:
Assisting with the setup, data collection, and administration of fNIRS & behavioral experiments.
Interacting closely with young children and older adults, to provide clear instructions and support during different experiment sessions.
Requirements:
Should be able to commit around 8 hours per week. Flexible weekday hours are available, but working on some weekends (Saturdays and/or Sundays) is a must.
Fluency in Cantonese is required. Possessing good communication skills, with the ability to speak loudly and clearly to ensure participants (especially older adults) understand experimental procedures.
Preferred Qualifications:
Undergraduate students (Year 2 or above) with a background in Psychology, Neuroscience, Linguistics, or other related disciplines. Interdisciplinary is also welcome.
Previous experience with fNIRS or Electroencephalogram (EEG), and working with older adults or children are significant advantages.
Candidates who are available to start immediately are preferred.
If you are interested, please fill in the form below via the following link:
https://forms.gle/eoQ4H2oetRPNkQKv5
For any inquiries, please contact May Leung (email: meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk; tel: 95867123) for more information.
大腦與認知研究所（The Brain and Mind Institute，BMI）現正招聘學生助理，以協助兩項實驗室內的學術研究項目：（一） 探討祖孫互動與聽力損失的項目；（二） 探討典型發展兒童與自閉症譜系障礙（ASD）兒童之間互動的項目。本研究採用功能性近紅外光譜成像技術 （fNIRS） 及其他行為評估，旨在量化實驗參加者互動與大腦活動的聯繫。獲聘者將會在王福元樓 406A 室或許讓城樓4樓值勤。
時薪：
$67/每小時
工作職責：
協助 fNIRS 及行為實驗的初始設置、數據收集與整理工作。
與兒童及長者密切溝通，在各實驗階段提供清晰的指令與實時支援。
申請要求：
工作時間每週需投入約 8 小時。平日工作時間可靈活安排，但必須能在部分週末（星期六及/或星期日）當值。
粵語流利。具備良好的溝通技巧。説話清晰、響亮，以確保被試（尤其長者）可充分理解實驗流程。
優先考慮條件：
心理學、神經科學、語言學或相關學科之本科生（Year 2或以上）；亦歡迎具備跨學科背景之同學申請。
具備 fNIRS 或 EEG（腦電圖）的相關經驗，以及與長者或兒童溝通合作的經驗者將獲優先考慮。
可立刻值勤者優先。

To introduce CUHK campus and cultural spots to participants;

(The application below is conducted in Chinese only.)
日期：2026年9月23日（星期三）
時間：下午12時半至2時
地點：香港中文大學利黃瑤璧樓5樓505室
語言：廣東話
講者：蔡利民博士（流星語音樂中心總監）
免費登記：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13736094
講座簡介：
1940年初，萍踪漂泊的女作家蕭紅（1911–1942）自重慶抵港，帶病完成了傳世之作《呼蘭河傳》。香港淪陷，蕭紅病逝，其夫端木蕻良將她部分骨灰葬在淺水灣麗都酒店前的海濱，及後又將其餘骨灰埋在聖士提反女校山坡之下。40年後，端木委託小思幫助尋找後一部分骨灰，但斜坡經歷維修，該部分骨灰至今下落不明。其實葬在淺水灣的部分骨灰，也有一番曲折奇遇。84年後，講者對淺水灣畔及聖士提反女子中學進行實地考察，嘗試向蕭紅埋骨之處再走近一步。
講者簡介：
蔡利民博士，香港出生及長大，現任流星語音樂中心總監，同時為自由寫作人。香港大學社會科學學士、美國加州大學洛杉磯分校社會學系文學碩士、香港中文大學決策科學與企管經濟系哲學博士。在學院所受的訓練是社會學及研究方法，一直對香港及港人故事具有濃厚興趣，著有散文集七本、委約專書《為您做足100分》、地區專題《踏着回憶走過來――從明華大廈開始》及歷史小說《消失的隧道》，另有「香港街角故事」系列專題文章多篇。

蔡利民博士，香港出生及長大，現任流星語音樂中心總監，同時為自由寫作人。香港大學社會科學學士、美國加州大學洛杉磯分校社會學系文學碩士、香港中文大學決策科學與企管經濟系哲學博士。在學院所受的訓練是社會學及研究方法，一直對香港及港人故事具有濃厚興趣，著有散文集七本、委約專書《為您做足100分》、地區專題《踏着回憶走過來――從明華大廈開始》及歷史小說《消失的隧道》，另有「香港街角故事」系列專題文章多篇。

Join us for a language adventure!
Applications for the Language Exchange Programme (LEP) are now open!
Learning a language and culture is always better with friends.
The LEP is back and connects you with peers from diverse backgrounds for real conversations, meaningful cultural exchange and engaging activities along the way!
What to expect:
Practise your target language (English, Cantonese, Putonghua or more) in a natural relaxed setting
Build lasting friendships with students from all around the world
Share and explore cultural insights you won't find in a textbook
Join interactive activities designed to make language learning more enjoyable
Spots are limited — sign up now and start your LEP journey!
Application Deadline: 18 September 2026, 23:59
Register now:
https://ilc.link/LEPReg
Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview on 24 – 25 September 2026

自學中心語言交換計劃（LEP）今個學期學期再次回歸，帶你喺互動交流中輕鬆學語言、識朋友、體驗多元文化！

透過真實互動練習英文、廣東話、普通話或更多語言
結識來自世界各地嘅朋友，建立跨文化友誼
體驗課本以外、更地道嘅文化交流
參與各種互動活動，令語言學習更輕鬆有趣
名額有限，快啲報名，展開你嘅 LEP 旅程啦！

Water Sports Training Course (Windsurfing & Sailing) - CUHK Water Sports Centre 水上活動訓練課程 (滑浪風帆及風帆) - 中大水上活動中心 - Water Sports Centre / P E Unit
From: Kent Wong

(The English version follows the Chinese one)
============ 中大水上活動中心通訊 =============
***** 訓練課程 *****
(更多資料: http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
獨木舟訓練班 (一天課程)
** 二星 (一天) : 10月3日 (六) (K13)
*** 三星 (一天) : 10月4日 (日) (K14)
初級滑浪風帆訓練班 (兩天課程) (適合初學人仕參與)
* 9月19 (六)及20 (日) (W7)
* 9月26 (六)及27 (日) (W8)
風帆入門訓練班 (第一級) (兩天課程)
* 10月31 (六)及11月1 (日) (S6)
# 為提供更完善的服務給您、中大不同部門及其他學會對水上活動的需要，本中心現特設 "度身訂造" 服務，馬上致電2603 6776聯絡我們吧!
***** 報名方式 *****
(更多資料: https://tinyurl.com/kxp3dwm2 or http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
網上報名網址：
https://webapp.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/ras/restricted/eventlist?id=73
# 查詢請致電2603 6776 (水上活動中心辦事處)。
***** 人數上限 *****
(更多資料: http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
+ 獨木舟訓練班：上限8人
+ 滑浪風帆訓練班：上限5人
+ 風帆訓練班：上限6人
***** 收費 *****
(更多資料: http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
+ 獨木舟訓練班：
** 初級課程 - 學生$210，職員 (及家屬) $270
+ 滑浪風帆訓練班：
** 初級課程 - 學生$630，職員 (及家屬) $700
+ 風帆入門訓練班：
** 第一級 - 學生$680，職員 (及家屬) $740
體育部將津貼獨木舟訓練班($90)，滑浪風帆及風帆訓練班($200)予全期出席之學生，退款將於課程後即時退回。
注意：
參加者須能穿著衣服及救生衣游泳50米。課程首日可能會安排游泳測試。
水上活動對體能有一定要求，參加者應確保身體狀況適合參與相關活動。
課程將以廣東話授課，並輔以英語說明。
報讀獨木舟二星證書課程或以上級別的參加者，必須於報名時出示相關資歷證明。未能提供有效證書者，本中心有權拒絕其報名申請。
參加者必須年滿14歲。18歲以下人士須取得家長、監護人或授權人士同意；16歲以下人士須由家長、監護人或授權人士陪同參與活動。陪同人士必須年滿 18歲。
課程費用僅包括教練費及器材使用費。成功完成課程並通過考核者，可申請相關證書。證書費用需另行支付：獨木舟$45、滑浪風帆$30及帆船$55 / $115
報名一經確認後，恕不接受退款、更改課程或更換參加者（包括因疾病而未能出席的情況）。惟因惡劣天氣、報名人數不足或本中心取消課程而導致的情況除外。
參加者須於課程當日自行前往水上活動中心集合。請自備泳衣、長袖上衣、適合下水使用且包趾包跟的運動鞋，以及午餐。
如報名人數不足，本中心保留取消課程的權利。受影響的參加者將獲個別電郵通知。
體育部將為出席率達 100% 的學生提供培訓津貼：獨木舟訓練($90)，滑浪風帆及帆船訓練($200)，津貼將於課程完成後發還。缺席或中途退出課程者將不獲發放津貼。
如有任何查詢，請聯絡：水上活動中心2603 6776 / 體育部：3943 6097
******* News for the Water Sports Training Course *******
Kayaking Training Course (1-day course):
** Two Star: 3 Oct (Sat) (K13)
*** Three Star: 4 Oct (Sun) (K14)
Basic Windsurfing Training Course (2-day course) (It also fit for Improver):
* 19-20 Sep (Sat & Sun) (W7)
* 26-27 Sep (Sat & Sun) (W8)
Introduction to Sailing Training Course (Level 1) (2-day course)
* 31 Oct to 1 Nov (Sat & Sun) (S6)
- The Centre offers a tailored package for all CUHK members (services include a fun day, a certificate course, and a special event); for more information, please call 2603 6776 (CUWSC Office).
******* Enrollment *******
Online enrollment will be accepted on a first-come, first-served basis until the course reaches its maximum capacity.
Direct register link for user:
https://webapp.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/ras/restricted/eventlist?id=73
******* Max capacity *******
+ Kayaking Training Course: Max. 8 persons
+ Windsurfing Training Course: Max. 5 persons
+ Sailing Training Course: Max. 6 persons
******* Course fee *******
+ Kayaking Training Course:
- Student ($210), Staff & Family member ($270)
+ Windsurfing Training Course:
- Student ($630), Staff & Family member ($700)
+ Introduction to Sailing Training Course (Level 1):
- Student ($680), Staff & Family member ($740)
Physical Education Unit will subsidize STUDENT with 100% attendance in Kayaking Training Course ($90) and Windsurfing / Sailing Training Course ($200). Subsidize will be refunded after the course except for abstention.
******** Contact us **********
Further information will be posted to Water Sports Centre Website (https://tinyurl.com/kxp3dwm2 or http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK), University Sports Centre notice board. We are welcome any inquiry kentwong@cuhk.edu.hk (email) & 2603 6776(OFFICE)
Remarks:
Participants should be able to swim 50 metres while wearing clothing and a life jacket. A swimming assessment may be conducted on the first day of the course.
Please note that water sports require a reasonable level of physical fitness. Participants should ensure they are physically fit to join the activity.
The course will be conducted primarily in Cantonese with supplementary instruction in English where necessary.
No refunds, program changes or participant substitutions will be permitted after enrollment, including cases of illness. Exceptions will only be made in the event of adverse weather conditions, insufficient enrollment or course cancellation by the Centre.
Participants enrolling in the Kayak 2 Star Award course or above must present the relevant qualification certificate upon registration. Failure to provide valid certification may result in the Centre declining the enrollment.
Participants must be aged 14 or above. Those under 18 years of age must obtain consent from a parent, guardian or authorized person. Participants under 16 years of age must be accompanied by a parent, guardian or authorized person throughout the activity. The accompanying parent, guardian or authorized person must be at least 18 years old.
The course fee covers instructor fees and equipment use only. Participants who successfully complete and pass the course assessment will be eligible to apply for a certificate. Certificate fees are charged separately: Kayaking $45, Windsurfing $30 and Sailing $55 / $115.
Participants should report directly to the Water Sports Centre on the course day. Please bring your own swimsuit, long-sleeved shirt, enclosed sports shoes suitable for water activities (covering both toes and heels) and lunch.
The course may be cancelled if the minimum enrollment requirement is not met. Affected participants will be notified individually by email.
The Physical Education Unit will provide a training subsidy for students who achieve 100% attendance: Kayaking Training $90 and Windsurfing / Sailing $200. The subsidy will be reimbursed after course completion. Participants who withdraw or are absent from the course will not be eligible for the subsidy.
For enquiries, please contact Water Sports Centre 2603-6776 or Physical Education Unit 3943-6097.

(更多資料: http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
獨木舟訓練班 (一天課程)
** 二星 (一天) : 10月3日 (六) (K13)
*** 三星 (一天) : 10月4日 (日) (K14)
初級滑浪風帆訓練班 (兩天課程) (適合初學人仕參與)
* 9月19 (六)及20 (日) (W7)
* 9月26 (六)及27 (日) (W8)
風帆入門訓練班 (第一級) (兩天課程)
* 10月31 (六)及11月1 (日) (S6)
# 為提供更完善的服務給您、中大不同部門及其他學會對水上活動的需要，本中心現特設 "度身訂造" 服務，馬上致電2603 6776聯絡我們吧!
***** 報名方式 *****
(更多資料: https://tinyurl.com/kxp3dwm2 or http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
網上報名網址：
https://webapp.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/ras/restricted/eventlist?id=73
# 查詢請致電2603 6776 (水上活動中心辦事處)。
***** 人數上限 *****
(更多資料: http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
+ 獨木舟訓練班：上限8人
+ 滑浪風帆訓練班：上限5人
+ 風帆訓練班：上限6人
***** 收費 *****
(更多資料: http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK)
+ 獨木舟訓練班：
** 初級課程 - 學生$210，職員 (及家屬) $270
+ 滑浪風帆訓練班：
** 初級課程 - 學生$630，職員 (及家屬) $700
+ 風帆入門訓練班：
** 第一級 - 學生$680，職員 (及家屬) $740
體育部將津貼獨木舟訓練班($90)，滑浪風帆及風帆訓練班($200)予全期出席之學生，退款將於課程後即時退回。
注意：
參加者須能穿著衣服及救生衣游泳50米。課程首日可能會安排游泳測試。
水上活動對體能有一定要求，參加者應確保身體狀況適合參與相關活動。
課程將以廣東話授課，並輔以英語說明。
報讀獨木舟二星證書課程或以上級別的參加者，必須於報名時出示相關資歷證明。未能提供有效證書者，本中心有權拒絕其報名申請。
參加者必須年滿14歲。18歲以下人士須取得家長、監護人或授權人士同意；16歲以下人士須由家長、監護人或授權人士陪同參與活動。陪同人士必須年滿 18歲。
課程費用僅包括教練費及器材使用費。成功完成課程並通過考核者，可申請相關證書。證書費用需另行支付：獨木舟$45、滑浪風帆$30及帆船$55 / $115
報名一經確認後，恕不接受退款、更改課程或更換參加者（包括因疾病而未能出席的情況）。惟因惡劣天氣、報名人數不足或本中心取消課程而導致的情況除外。
參加者須於課程當日自行前往水上活動中心集合。請自備泳衣、長袖上衣、適合下水使用且包趾包跟的運動鞋，以及午餐。
如報名人數不足，本中心保留取消課程的權利。受影響的參加者將獲個別電郵通知。
體育部將為出席率達 100% 的學生提供培訓津貼：獨木舟訓練($90)，滑浪風帆及帆船訓練($200)，津貼將於課程完成後發還。缺席或中途退出課程者將不獲發放津貼。
如有任何查詢，請聯絡：水上活動中心2603 6776 / 體育部：3943 6097
******* News for the Water Sports Training Course *******
Kayaking Training Course (1-day course):
** Two Star: 3 Oct (Sat) (K13)
*** Three Star: 4 Oct (Sun) (K14)
Basic Windsurfing Training Course (2-day course) (It also fit for Improver):
* 19-20 Sep (Sat & Sun) (W7)
* 26-27 Sep (Sat & Sun) (W8)
Introduction to Sailing Training Course (Level 1) (2-day course)
* 31 Oct to 1 Nov (Sat & Sun) (S6)
- The Centre offers a tailored package for all CUHK members (services include a fun day, a certificate course, and a special event); for more information, please call 2603 6776 (CUWSC Office).
******* Enrollment *******
Online enrollment will be accepted on a first-come, first-served basis until the course reaches its maximum capacity.
Direct register link for user:
https://webapp.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/ras/restricted/eventlist?id=73
******* Max capacity *******
+ Kayaking Training Course: Max. 8 persons
+ Windsurfing Training Course: Max. 5 persons
+ Sailing Training Course: Max. 6 persons
******* Course fee *******
+ Kayaking Training Course:
- Student ($210), Staff & Family member ($270)
+ Windsurfing Training Course:
- Student ($630), Staff & Family member ($700)
+ Introduction to Sailing Training Course (Level 1):
- Student ($680), Staff & Family member ($740)
Physical Education Unit will subsidize STUDENT with 100% attendance in Kayaking Training Course ($90) and Windsurfing / Sailing Training Course ($200). Subsidize will be refunded after the course except for abstention.
******** Contact us **********
Further information will be posted to Water Sports Centre Website (https://tinyurl.com/kxp3dwm2 or http://www.facebook.com/WSC.CUHK), University Sports Centre notice board. We are welcome any inquiry kentwong@cuhk.edu.hk (email) & 2603 6776(OFFICE)
Remarks:
Participants should be able to swim 50 metres while wearing clothing and a life jacket. A swimming assessment may be conducted on the first day of the course.
Please note that water sports require a reasonable level of physical fitness. Participants should ensure they are physically fit to join the activity.
The course will be conducted primarily in Cantonese with supplementary instruction in English where necessary.
No refunds, program changes or participant substitutions will be permitted after enrollment, including cases of illness. Exceptions will only be made in the event of adverse weather conditions, insufficient enrollment or course cancellation by the Centre.
Participants enrolling in the Kayak 2 Star Award course or above must present the relevant qualification certificate upon registration. Failure to provide valid certification may result in the Centre declining the enrollment.
Participants must be aged 14 or above. Those under 18 years of age must obtain consent from a parent, guardian or authorized person. Participants under 16 years of age must be accompanied by a parent, guardian or authorized person throughout the activity. The accompanying parent, guardian or authorized person must be at least 18 years old.
The course fee covers instructor fees and equipment use only. Participants who successfully complete and pass the course assessment will be eligible to apply for a certificate. Certificate fees are charged separately: Kayaking $45, Windsurfing $30 and Sailing $55 / $115.
Participants should report directly to the Water Sports Centre on the course day. Please bring your own swimsuit, long-sleeved shirt, enclosed sports shoes suitable for water activities (covering both toes and heels) and lunch.
The course may be cancelled if the minimum enrollment requirement is not met. Affected participants will be notified individually by email.
The Physical Education Unit will provide a training subsidy for students who achieve 100% attendance: Kayaking Training $90 and Windsurfing / Sailing $200. The subsidy will be reimbursed after course completion. Participants who withdraw or are absent from the course will not be eligible for the subsidy.
For enquiries, please contact Water Sports Centre 2603-6776 or Physical Education Unit 3943-6097.
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

bodyText:

The Independent Learning Centre (ILC) offers a wide range of workshops and activities to support learning of language and communication skills. Visit our website for more information: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ (20260914)  - ILC
From: ILC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ilc-counsel@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【Weekly Highlights - English Section 】
A. Communication, Study Skills and Job Preparation Workshops
The Independent Learning Centre offers English workshops 14 September to 18 September: (1) Ace Your Oral Presentations, (2) Saying What You Mean - English Pronunciation for Cantonese and Mandarin Speakers, (3) Preparing for the Common Recruitment Examination (CRE) - Use of English (UE), (4) Global Citizenship Series: Sustainable Consumption, and (5) Happy Hour @ ILC: Boardgame FUNdamentals!. These workshops are now available for registration at: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in English
Consultation service is available during the following time:
14 September (Mon): 14:30 – 16:30
15 September (Tue): 10:30 – 12:30
16 September (Wed): 14:30 – 16:30
17 September (Thu): 10:30 – 12:30
15 September (Fri): 10:30 – 12:30
Online Booking:
https://ilccuhk.as.me/schedule.php
More Timeslot please check our website：
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EH/consultation.aspx
====================================
【Weekly Highlights - Chinese Section 】中文部本週活動
A. Chinese Workshops 中文工作坊
The Independent Learning Centre offers Chinese workshops 14 September to 18 September: (1) BLNST Basic Law Test, (2) Grammar for the CRE, (3) JRE Argumentative Writing I, and (4) Preparing for the CRE. These workshops are now available for registration at: https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
自學中心九月十四日至九月十八日舉辦 (1) BLNST基本法及香港國安法測試 (基本法部份), (2) 「CHLT大學中文 」寫作專題研習：演講辭, (3) CRE中文運用應試實戰班：字詞辨識(粵), (4) 公務員綜合招聘試系列(CRE)：病句分析基礎, (5) CRE中文運用應試實戰班：句子辨析(粵), (6) JRE 議論文寫作 (一), (7) CRE中文運用應試實戰班：詞句運用(粵), 及 (8) 公務員綜合招聘試系列(CRE)：中文運用等工作坊，歡迎報名。
登記連結： https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in Chinese 自學中心中文輔導服務
Consultation service is available during the following time:
自學中心於九月十四日至九月十八日提供以下中文輔導時段。
15 September (Tue): 14:30 – 16:30
16 September (Wed): 14:30 – 16:30
17 September (Thu): 10:30 – 12:30
網上預約：
https://ilccuhk.as.me/schedule.php
更多中文輔導時段。
====================================
C. “The Power of Words” 「書寫力量」
This is a reading and writing event organized by the ILC, Hong Kong Literature Research Centre, the Office of Arts Administrator (OAA) and Tolopoem. Activities we have this semester include Blackboard / Glass Wall Poems, Talks of Dialogue in the Arts and Workshops.
自學中心、香港文學研究中心、藝術行政主任辦公室及吐露詩社合辦的大型閱讀及寫作活動。這個學期的活動，除黑板詩及玻璃詩外，還有藝文縱談及各式工作坊。各項活動的資料可以參看：https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/Event/thepowerofwords.aspx
====================================
【Independent Online Learning Resources】自學中心網上自學資源
A. Independent Online Learning Resources in English
- Academic Writing
Visit this link on academic writing skills and convention for different citation styles:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Writing.aspx
- Vocabulary
Visit this link for both General Vocabulary and Specific Vocabulary (e.g. For Business and Medical Professionals) lists and practices:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Vocab.aspx
- Job Search and Interviews
Visit this link to identify your capabilities and personality types, learn how to prepare job search documents and personal statements, and how to get ready for job interviews:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/JobSearching.aspx
B. Independent Online Learning Resources in Chinese中文網上自學材料
- Academic Writing論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on academic writing, with highlights on structure, expressions, common grammatical mistakes, etc.
針對大學生撰寫學術論文時所遇到的困難，提供實用的知識和練習。內容包括：學期論文的結構與寫作步驟、常見語法錯誤、表達與語言邏輯等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/AWOnline/general1.html
- ‘Pulewang’ Online Putonghua Platform「普樂網」網上普通話平台
An online Putonghua learning platform designed for CU students. Essential knowledge of Putonghua is introduced with interactive exercises and games. Extended conversational exchanges on selected topics of social affairs and student life are available for oral practice with texts and pinyin.
針對本校同學學習需要的網上普通話平台，內容圍繞大學生的學習與日常生活，設計深入淺出，每單元均有練習與遊戲，互動有趣，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/Chinese/plw/index.html
- Argumentative Writing議論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on the structure, the content and the language of argumentative writing.
介紹議論文的結構及寫作要求，以解說、例子及練習，呈現寫作議論時要注意的內容及語言特點：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/arguWriting/001.html
- Cantonese Pronunciation粵語拼音速遞
This guide is designed for mainland students as an effective way to learn Cantonese pronunciation. Basic knowledge of Cantonese syllables is introduced with exercises. Comparison of Cantonese and Putonghua pronunciation is also highlighted
協助內地同學迅速掌握粵語發音。內容包括：語音基礎、粵普對比、難點練習等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/cantontones/_home/index.html
- Cantonese Express港式粵語速遞
An interactive introduction to Hong Kong style Cantonese. Daily expressions and situational conversations are introduced with interactive exercises.
以有趣互動的方式介紹港式粵語，包括日常生活用語、情景會話、互動練習等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/canton_express/others/frontpage.html
- Online Cantonese for Foreigners
A free online platform for international students to learn basic Cantonese. The texts are clear and simple, and interactive exercises easy to use: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/can_eng/layout.html
- Online Putonghua for Foreigners
Do you know how to make orders in a Chinese restaurant and learn how to bargain when you travel in China? Here are some situational conversations and basic knowledge of Putonghua to learn online: https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/CHResources/Lang_PTH_EnglishSpk.aspx
- Online Platform for Successful Chinese Learning (OPSCL) 中國語言及文化自學資源網
Online Platform for Successful Chinese Learning (OPSCL) is a biliterate (English and Chinese) online platform that contains reviews of learning materials suitable for autodidactic study in the 5 big areas of Mandarin, Cantonese, Chinese Characters, Chinese Culture, and Hong Kong Culture. Electronic learning materials that is good for self-learning would be review. Each review consists of a description and other useful information. Users can search for resources by various criteria, rate the resources, and write their own comments. A self-assessment system is also provided so as to recommend an entry point to the users according to their current level.
中國語言及文化自學資源網(OPSCL)為一推薦自學資源之網上平台。平台為有意學習普通話、粵語、漢字、中國文化或香港文化等五大範疇的人士提供中文及英文雙語之學習資源，以推動自主學習與終身學習。平台內推薦的資源均附有簡介及評語，使用者可按自身需要搜尋學習資源，並在使用後給予評分或評論，以備其他使用者參考。此外，平台設有「自評系統」，使用者可通過完成自評，確定自身的學習起步點，從而尋找適合自己程度的學習資源。
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/Workshop/ChineseLanguageAndCulture/EN/index.aspx
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/Workshop/ChineseLanguageAndCulture/TC/index.aspx
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/Workshop/ChineseLanguageAndCulture/SC/index.aspx
====================================

A. Communication, Study Skills and Job Preparation Workshops
The Independent Learning Centre offers English workshops 14 September to 18 September: (1) Ace Your Oral Presentations, (2) Saying What You Mean - English Pronunciation for Cantonese and Mandarin Speakers, (3) Preparing for the Common Recruitment Examination (CRE) - Use of English (UE), (4) Global Citizenship Series: Sustainable Consumption, and (5) Happy Hour @ ILC: Boardgame FUNdamentals!. A. Independent Online Learning Resources in English
- Academic Writing

https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Writing.aspx
- Vocabulary

https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Vocab.aspx
- Job Search and Interviews
Visit this link to identify your capabilities and personality types, learn how to prepare job search documents and personal statements, and how to get ready for job interviews:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/JobSearching.aspx
B. Independent Online Learning Resources in Chinese中文網上自學材料
- Academic Writing論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on academic writing, with highlights on structure, expressions, common grammatical mistakes, etc.
針對大學生撰寫學術論文時所遇到的困難，提供實用的知識和練習。內容包括：學期論文的結構與寫作步驟、常見語法錯誤、表達與語言邏輯等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/AWOnline/general1.html
- ‘Pulewang’ Online Putonghua Platform「普樂網」網上普通話平台
An online Putonghua learning platform designed for CU students. Essential knowledge of Putonghua is introduced with interactive exercises and games. Extended conversational exchanges on selected topics of social affairs and student life are available for oral practice with texts and pinyin.
針對本校同學學習需要的網上普通話平台，內容圍繞大學生的學習與日常生活，設計深入淺出，每單元均有練習與遊戲，互動有趣，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/Chinese/plw/index.html
- Argumentative Writing議論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on the structure, the content and the language of argumentative writing.
介紹議論文的結構及寫作要求，以解說、例子及練習，呈現寫作議論時要注意的內容及語言特點：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/arguWriting/001.html
- Cantonese Pronunciation粵語拼音速遞
This guide is designed for mainland students as an effective way to learn Cantonese pronunciation. Basic knowledge of Cantonese syllables is introduced with exercises. Comparison of Cantonese and Putonghua pronunciation is also highlighted
協助內地同學迅速掌握粵語發音。內容包括：語音基礎、粵普對比、難點練習等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/cantontones/_home/index.html
- Cantonese Express港式粵語速遞
An interactive introduction to Hong Kong style Cantonese. Daily expressions and situational conversations are introduced with interactive exercises.
以有趣互動的方式介紹港式粵語，包括日常生活用語、情景會話、互動練習等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/canton_express/others/frontpage.html
- Online Cantonese for Foreigners
A free online platform for international students to learn basic Cantonese. The texts are clear and simple, and interactive exercises easy to use: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/can_eng/layout.html
- Online Putonghua for Foreigners
Do you know how to make orders in a Chinese restaurant and learn how to bargain when you travel in China? Here are some situational conversations and basic knowledge of Putonghua to learn online: https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/CHResources/Lang_PTH_EnglishSpk.aspx
- Online Platform for Successful Chinese Learning (OPSCL) 中國語言及文化自學資源網
Online Platform for Successful Chinese Learning (OPSCL) is a biliterate (English and Chinese) online platform that contains reviews of learning materials suitable for autodidactic study in the 5 big areas of Mandarin, Cantonese, Chinese Characters, Chinese Culture, and Hong Kong Culture. Electronic learning materials that is good for self-learning would be review. Each review consists of a description and other useful information. Users can search for resources by various criteria, rate the resources, and write their own comments. A self-assessment system is also provided so as to recommend an entry point to the users according to their current level.
中國語言及文化自學資源網(OPSCL)為一推薦自學資源之網上平台。平台為有意學習普通話、粵語、漢字、中國文化或香港文化等五大範疇的人士提供中文及英文雙語之學習資源，以推動自主學習與終身學習。平台內推薦的資源均附有簡介及評語，使用者可按自身需要搜尋學習資源，並在使用後給予評分或評論，以備其他使用者參考。此外，平台設有「自評系統」，使用者可通過完成自評，確定自身的學習起步點，從而尋找適合自己程度的學習資源。

All about further studies — where to study and how to sell yourselves to the university?
If you are considering applying for postgraduate programmes, you will have to think of where you are going and how to get in. It is important to know where to search for relevant information effectively and efficiently, and what to write in your personal statement to communicate with your target university the reasons for applying and your suitability.

Announcements
[!!!!Earn 60HKD!!!!!] Invite Local Hong Kong and Mainland Chinese listeners to an online listening study  【!!!!賺取 60 港元!!!!!】誠邀本地香港和内地人士參與網上聽力研究 - Department of English, Faculty of Arts
From: ZHOU Kaijun
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
kai.zhou@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Mr. ZHOU Kaijun (Kai), a PhD candidate in the Department of English at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), is recruiting
Hong Kong and Mainland Chinese participants
for an online listening study.
Eligibility Criteria
To participate, you must:
Be either:
a Hong Kong permanent resident holding a valid Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card; or
a Mainland Chinese resident holding a valid People’s Republic of China Resident Identity Card;
Be a native speaker of Cantonese or Mandarin;
Have an IELTS score of 6.5 or above, a TOEFL score of 79 or above, or equivalent proof of English proficiency;
Be comfortable using a computer keyboard;
Not be majoring, or have majored, in (Applied) Linguistics, Audiology, Speech Therapy, Speech-Language Pathology, Communication Disorders, Language Sciences, or a related discipline;
Not be of mixed ethnic background; and
Have no known hearing impairment.
What You Will Do
After your eligibility has been confirmed, you will receive a link to an online research questionnaire involving a listening task. The study will take approximately 1 to 1.5 hours to complete.
You must use a laptop or desktop computer to participate.
Compensation
Participants who complete all study tasks will receive
HK$60
via the Faster Payment System (FPS).
If you meet the above criteria and are interested in participating, please email Mr. Kai at
kai.zhou@link.cuhk.edu.hk
to express your interest.
香港中文大學英文系博士研究生ZHOU Kaijun先生（Kai）現正為一項網上聆聽研究招募香港及中國內地參加者。
參加資格
參加者必須符合以下所有條件：
屬於以下其中一類人士：
持有有效香港永久性居民身份證的香港永久性居民；或
持有有效中華人民共和國居民身份證的中國內地居民；
以粵語或普通話為母語；
雅思（IELTS）成績達6.5分或以上、托福（TOEFL）成績達79分或以上，或能提供其他同等英語能力證明；
能熟練使用電腦鍵盤；
現時並非修讀，亦未曾主修（應用）語言學、聽力學、言語治療、言語及語言病理學、溝通障礙、語言科學或其他相關學科；

對表演有興趣？對寫作有想法？
帶你從零開始探索劇場表演與文本創作的樂趣！
無須任何表演或編劇經驗，純粹帶上你的好奇心！
專業導師親自引導！

演員初體驗工作坊
(
The First Take Workshop)

我/演員/角色，其實都離不開「我」，
透過不同練習，開發肢體、探索聲音、加強空間意識和節奏感、深化想像力。
帶著第三隻眼睛，連結自己觀察世界，
讓不同的「我」和「我」在生活/表演的舞台美好的相遇。

Announcements
Love Healthy Eating? Turn Your Passion into Impact! Join our Healthy Cooking Project and empower secondary school students to eat healthier. 熱愛健康飲食？加入健康煮食導師團隊，發揮你的影響力！ 加入學生健康由煮起計劃，與中學生一起煮出健康未來！ - Centre for Health Education and Health Promotion
From: Calvin Cheung
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
chep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Recruitment of University Students as Healthy Cooking Tutors
Are you passionate about healthy eating? Do you want to influence the younger generation through service learning? We sincerely invite students who value a healthy lifestyle to join our Healthy Cooking Project as Healthy Cooking Tutors and become a driving force in shaping healthier dietary habits among secondary school students!
The “Healthy Cooking Project” is funded by the Quality Education Fund (QEF) and aims to promote healthy eating among secondary school students. Organized by the Centre for Health Education and Health Promotion at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, the project will first train university students to become Healthy Cooking Tutors. These tutors will then lead healthy cooking interest groups in secondary schools to promote healthy eating. The goal is to enhance university students’ awareness of healthy eating while empowering them to share their knowledge with secondary school students, fulfilling the vision of "Life Influencing Life." University students with or without cooking experience are welcome to join!
Programme Details
Training
: A total of 5 sessions will be held on Fridays PM or Saturdays AM from mid-October to mid-November 2026 at the Activity Room on 4/F of Lek Yuen Health Centre in Sha Tin. The training will equip you with knowledge of healthy eating and practical skills in preparing healthy food.
Practical Experience
: After completing the training, you will be assigned to a secondary school to lead 7 healthy cooking sessions from November 2026 to June 2027. You will guide students in preparing healthy snacks and dishes while promoting healthy eating habits.
Allowance
: You will receive a HK$134 allowance for each healthy cooking session conducted at the assigned secondary school.
Why Join Us?
Enhance Your Knowledge of Healthy Eating
: Learn more about nutrition and health while developing practical healthy cooking skills for a healthier lifestyle.
Service Learning Experience
: Gain valuable leadership and communication experience through teaching secondary school students while enhancing your resume.
Life Influencing Life
: Experience the fulfillment of guiding young people to build healthy eating habits.
Personal Growth
: Develop a sense of responsibility, confidence, and teamwork skills—laying a foundation for your future career.
Eligibility
University students (from any discipline) are welcome.
Passionate about healthy eating and serving youth, and willing to interact with secondary school students.
Able to commit to completing 5 training sessions and 7 healthy cooking sessions.
Able to read and understand Chinese and communicate in Cantonese.
How to Apply
Please submit the
online application
form by 27 September 2026.
For Enquiries
Please contact Nicole Ma, Research Assistant Phone: 2693 3708 Email:
chep@cuhk.edu.hk
招募大學生成為健康煮食導師
你熱衷於健康飲食？想透過服務學習影響年輕一代？我們誠邀重視健康生活的你，加入「學生健康由煮起計劃」健康煮食導師的行列，成為改變中學生飲食習慣的推動者！
「學生健康由煮起計劃」是獲優質教育基金（QEF）資助、向中學生推廣健康飲食的計劃。計劃由香港中文大學健康教育及促進健康中心推動，首先培訓大學生成為健康煮食導師，然後安排導師以課後健康煮食興趣小組形式向中學推廣健康飲食，期望在提升大學生健康飲食意識之餘，亦能將所學與中學生分享，達至生命影響生命的目的。無論有否煮食經驗的大學生均可參與！
計劃安排
培訓課程
：共5節，於2026年10至11月的星期五或六在沙田瀝源健康院4樓活動室舉行，助你掌握健康飲食知識及健康食物製作技巧。
實踐機會
：完成培訓後，你將獲安排於2026年11至2027年6月以健康煮食導師身份，前往一所中學主持7節健康飲食活動，與中學生一同製作健康小食或菜式。
津貼
：在中學完成每節健康煮食活動可獲$134津貼。
為什麼參與？
提升健康飲食知識
：更多了解營養與健康，以及實踐健康煮食方法，成為更健康的自己。
服務學習經驗
：透過教授中學生，累積寶貴的領導和溝通經驗，提升個人履歷。
生命影響生命
：親手引導年輕人建立健康飲食習慣，體驗改變他人的滿足感。
個人成長
：培養責任感、自信心及團隊合作能力，為未來投身社會奠定基礎。
參加資格
大學生（任何學系均可）。
對健康飲食及服務青少年有熱誠，樂於與中學生互動。
能承諾完成5節培訓及7節中學活動。
能夠閱讀和理解中文，並能以廣東話表達。
如何報名？
請於2026年9月27日前提交
網上報名表
。
聯繫我們
如有查詢，請聯繫研究助理Nicole Ma（電話：2693 3708 / 電郵：chep@cuhk.edu.hk）。
View Count

：完成培訓後，你將獲安排於2026年11至2027年6月以健康煮食導師身份，前往一所中學主持7節健康飲食活動，與中學生一同製作健康小食或菜式。

：在中學完成每節健康煮食活動可獲$134津貼。

提升健康飲食知識

大學生（任何學系均可）。
對健康飲食及服務青少年有熱誠，樂於與中學生互動。
能承諾完成5節培訓及7節中學活動。

請於2026年9月27日前提交
網上報名表
。

For non-tonal language speakers What's the difference between mā and má? Get 400 HKD to discover !！

Can you hear the difference between mā and má? How does your brain learn language tones? Join our study and put your ears to the test!
In our study, you will attend two sessions:
In the first session (EEG), you will wear a comfortable sensor cap so we can record your brain activity while you listen to sounds. (Safe & Non-invasive!)
In the second session (Behavioral), you will conduct interactive computer-based tasks that test your focus and memory.

prior experience with Mandarin or Cantonese is required — we welcome everyone as long as you are eligible!

A unique opportunity to see how your brain works
Learn something new about tones and language learning
$400 compensation for your time

We will contact you later to schedule an experiment with you if you are eligible.

Aged 18–30; NOT majoring in psychology or linguistics.
Be a non-tonal language native speaker (e.g. non-Mandarin/non-Cantonese).
Normal hearing and vision.
No history of brain injury, epilepsy, or other neurological conditions; no scalp injuries or infections.
Right-handed, healthy, no hair dyeing within two weeks before the experiment.

title: Communication Seminar Series - Life Mediated: The Hidden Injuries of Visibility
bodyText:

Communication Seminar Series - Life Mediated: The Hidden Injuries of Visibility  - School of Journalism and Communication
From: School of Journalism and Communication
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
com@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Communication Seminar Series - Life Mediated: The Hidden Injuries of Visibility
Date: 24 September 2026 (Thursday)
Time: 11:30am-1:00pm
Venue: C-Centre (NAH313, Humanities Building, CUHK)
Speaker:
Prof. Bingchun Meng
Professor
Department of Media and Communications
London School of Economics and Political Science, UK
Abstract:
Being seen has become work. On Chinese social media, mompreneurs, rural creators and street livestreamers perform themselves daily to earn a living, or simply to count. This talk asks about the costs of sustaining such visibility. Sociologists Sennett and Cobb once described the "hidden injuries of class": the private sense of failure people carry for conditions they didn't create. Platforms haven't removed that mechanism, only rebuilt it on algorithmic terms. Injury used to be hidden because no one was looking; now it's hidden because everyone is. The speaker calls these arrangements
regimes of managed justification
: self-presentation is tested continuously against standards that are never explained and impossible to appeal, its value taken by the platform, its verdict returned as a judgment on the person. Platforms hand people real means to act while removing the language for naming what is being done to them.
Language: English

From: Artist-in-Residence Programme

Dear students,
We warmly invite you to join the
Masterclass “
You Are Everything: An Intermedia Improvisation Workshop”
, led by
Jen Shyu, CUHK Artist-in-Residence 2026
.
Date: 29 September 2026 (Tuesday)
Time: 2:30–4:30 pm
Venue: Multi-Purpose Area, 2/F, Yasumoto International Academic Park (YIA)
Quota: 25 (First-come; first-served. No formal music or arts training is required.)
Language: English
Registration (by 21 September):
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737005
Through interactive poetry, song, movement, theatre and improvisation, Jen Shyu will guide participants in connecting across disciplines, cultures and perspectives. This welcoming and interactive workshop offers a chance to try something new, meet others and develop skills for creative expression, presentations, teaching and teamwork.
Participants who are particularly interested may have an opportunity to perform with Jen Shyu on 13 October 2026.
Notes:
Please bring a pen or pencil, and a small notebook or paper for writing. (Optional: musical instruments, paints, markers, canvas or other art materials.)
Please wear comfortable clothing and flat shoes suitable for movement
Participants may be asked to remove their shoes, if applicable.
For enquiries, please contact
airp@cuhk.edu.hk
.

https://www.jenshyu.com/
About the Programme:
https://www.arts.cuhk.edu.hk/web/cuhk-artist-in-residence/jen-shyu
各位同學：
2026年度中大駐校藝術家計劃誠邀大家參加本年度駐校藝術家徐秋雁主持的大師班 – 「你就是一切：跨媒介即興創作工作坊」。
日期︰2026年9月29日（星期二）
時間︰下午2:30分 – 4時30分
地點︰香港中文大學康本國際學術園二樓多用途活動室
名額︰25
語言︰英語
報名（9月21日截止）︰https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737005
徐秋雁將運用詩歌、歌唱、身體律動、劇場及即興創作等元素，帶領來自不同學科、文化及背景的學生，在輕鬆、愉快及互動的氛圍中交流互動、建立聯繫，一起探索嶄新的可能，發掘多元的創作方式。
參加者亦可透過活動提升創意表達、公開演講、簡報及團隊合作等能力。對活動特別感興趣的參加者，更有機會於2026年10月13日與徐秋雁同台演出。
備註︰
•        請帶備原子筆或鉛筆，以及筆記簿或書寫用紙；
•        請穿著方便活動的舒適衣物及平底鞋；
•        歡迎自行帶備樂器、顏料、彩色筆、畫布或其他藝術材料

Full-time undergraduates or postgraduates of any discipline;
Solid verbal skill in both Cantonese and Mandarin is desirable.
Candidates with skills in Microsoft Excel, data analysis, and general IT applications will be an advantage
Job Duties:
Handling survey data and preparing reports as required
Phone calls to graduates to conduct survey
Documentation

Monday to Friday
Time:

(Detailed timeslots will be discussed after your application)

2026-2027 Voluntary User-Pay Dental Service Scheme (VUPDSS)
Voluntary User-Pay Dental Service Scheme (VUPDSS) is a voluntary and self-paid dental service between the University’s members and the service providers, Health & Care Dental Services Limited and Quality HealthCare Dental Services Limited. Its primary purpose is to provide participants the additional convenience of receiving dental service at contracted dental clinics outside campus at concessionary rate. Full-time students, full-time staff and dependents, eligible retirees and dependents can enroll in the Scheme. The Scheme is open for application. Membership is valid from 1 September 2026 to 31 August 2027.
Details of the Scheme is available at:
https://www.umso.cuhk.edu.hk/form-download/
2026-2027 自費牙科服務計劃
「自費牙科服務計劃」為一個自願性付費形式的牙齒保健計劃。 合資格大學成員可參加由恒健牙科服務有限公司及卓健牙科服務有限公司所提供的牙科保健服務。 本計劃旨在為參加者提供一個具彈性及享有優惠價格之牙科服務。 全日制學生、全職職員及家屬、合資格退休員工及家屬均可參加。 計劃現正接受申請，會籍有效期由2026年9月1日至2027年8月31日。
計劃詳情，請瀏覽網頁:
https://www.umso.cuhk.edu.hk/hk/form-download/

Calling all CUHK students! Ready to use GenAI to make a real-world impact?
I highly encourage you to participate in the Hong Kong Inter-University GenAI Hackathon for SDGs 2026!
This month-long hackathon is an incredible opportunity to apply multimodal GenAI technologies towards the UN SDGs. You will get the chance to collaborate with peers across different universities, research pressing social issues, and prototype innovative, socially beneficial solutions.
Beyond coding, this hackathon is about building your 21st-century skills, expanding your network, and stepping into the world of social entrepreneurship and start-up incubation.
Kick-off / Launch Day Details:
Date: Saturday, 19 September 2026
Time: 9:30 am – 3:00 pm (HKT)
Venue: Lecture Hall II, Centennial Campus, HKU
Don't miss this chance to build tech for good!

bodyText:

2026/09/11
»
Announcements
【Earn HK$500 coupon】 Recruiting adults (aged 18-65) to participate in research on online therapy for insomnia 【可獲得 500元現金券】招募成年人 (18-65歲)參與失眠的數碼化治療研究 - Psychiatry
From: Charis
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你是否經常在床上輾轉難眠，夜醒或早醒？你並不孤單——許多人都面臨著同樣的問題。我們誠邀您參與研究，讓專業數碼化治療助你改善睡眠！
研究目的
本研究旨在評估市民對數碼化失眠認知行為治療聊天機器人的遵從性，以及其對改善睡眠問題的效果。
治療方式
· 由專業臨床心理學家及精神科醫生設計的電子化治療
· 完全免費
參與資格
· 18至65歲能說廣東話流利溝通（能流利閱讀並理解廣東話）的香港居民
· 在過去一個月內，每週至少三晚出現睡眠困擾
· 最近四周或以上無需長期服藥
參與研究，獲得獎勵！
完成所有治療及後續測試後，您可獲得高達500港幣。
如何加入？
請點擊以下連結進行註冊，並回答幾條簡單問題。研究員將聯絡適合的參加者，詳細解釋研究內容：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4UPFh054GtJGXX0
聯絡我們
如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理聯絡。
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Do you often toss and turn in bed, wake up frequently at night, or wake up too early? You are not alone—many people experience the same challenges. We invite you to participate in our study and explore professional digital treatment to improve your sleep!
Purpose of the Study
This research aims to evaluate the public’s adherence to a digital insomnia cognitive behavioural therapy chatbot and assess its effectiveness in improving sleep problems.
Treatment Method
· A professionally designed digital therapy created by clinical psychologists and psychiatrists
· Completely free of charge
Eligibility Criteria
· Hong Kong residents aged 18 to 65 who can speak in Cantonese fluently, read and understand Cantonese
· Experienced sleep disturbances at least 3 nights per week in the past month
· No need for long-term medication for the past four weeks or more.
Receive Rewards for Participating!
Upon completion of all treatment sessions and follow-up assessments, participants will receive up to HKD 500.
How to Join?
Click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact suitable participants to provide further details:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4UPFh054GtJGXX0
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/
