2026-27 The Friends of the Arts Scheme 2026-27 The Friends of the Arts 計劃 - The Office of the Arts Administrator
From: Dorothy Yuen
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
cuoaa@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
26-27 The Friends of the Arts開始接受報名啦！
「Friends of the Arts」（FTA）由藝術行政主任辦公室主辦，旨在為中大全日制學生提供更多接觸藝術、體驗藝術的機會，拉近大家與藝術之間的距離，探索藝術文化的多元面貌。本計劃將持續舉辦不同類型的藝術活動，讓各位透過參與體驗，發掘興趣、拓闊視野，並從不同藝術形式中獲得啟發，豐富校園生活。
無論你是資深藝術迷，還是想踏出接觸藝術的第一步，都歡迎加入，一同成為 Friends of the Arts！
計劃為期一年：2026年9月1日 至 2027年4月30日。
截止日期: 2026年10月30日（五）
對象：
香港中文大學全日制學生
會員費用：
$250
基本禮遇：
．2張本地演出門票
．1張展覽門票
．1次文化工作坊/本地文化遊（任選其一）
額外福利：
．會員專屬藝術資訊平台，接收最新藝文訊息
．與藝術文化導賞員或資深藝術家交流
．與不同科系背景的藝文同好交流
．優先參與OAA藝術活動
．豐富校內學生發展組合(Student Development Portfolio) 紀錄

2026-27 Friends of the Arts is now recruiting new members!
organized by the Office of the Arts Administrator, the scheme provides chance for full-time CUHK students to explore different art forms and enrich their campus life. A variety of arts-related activities allowing students to discover new interests, broaden their horizons, and gain inspiration through hands-on participation and cultural experiences.
Whether you are a passionate arts enthusiast or looking to take your first step into the world of arts and culture, you are warmly invited to join FTA and become a
Friend of the Arts
!

Application Deadline：2026-10-30 (Fri)
Target：Full-time CUHK Students
Membership Fee: $250
Basic (4 event quota, classified as follows:
．2 local arts performance tickets
．1 exhibition ticket
．1 Art workshop or local cultural tour (*select one)
Other Benefits:
．Receive the latest arts and cultural news through an exclusive members’ platform
．Meet the artists
．Interact with arts lovers from various disciplines
．Have priority to participate in OAA activities
．Enrich CUHK I-CARE Student Development Portfolio

Announcements
HKD200 CASH -- Invitation to participate in a research about Enhancing Awareness of Autism in Hong Kong  - Department of Educational Psychology
From: Catherine So
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
wingchee@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear Students,
We are researchers from the Department of Educational Psychology at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. We are inviting 400 students (major or minor in programs *other than* Education) to participate in the "Project to Enhance Awareness of Autism in Hong Kong." You will be reimbursed
HKD200 in CASH
if you complete the questionnaires in two separate time intervals in Room 614 at Sino Building. Please be advised that the incentive will be awarded upon the completion of the online questionnaires *within specified intervals*.
Registration link: https://forms.gle/8gtrFQoowH2ApyR1A
Students who have taken UGED1998 and UGED1999 during AY2025/2026 are not eligible to participate in this research.
Students (N=400) will complete various
online assessments (in English).
You are expected to complete these questions in
30-45 minutes at each of the two time points (Time 1 & Time 2).
By participating in this research, students will benefit from gaining knowledge of neurodivergent populations such as those with autism and ADHD. There is no risk involved in participating in this research. Participation is entirely voluntary, and you may choose to withdraw at any time. This research has been approved by the Survey and Behavioral Research Ethics (SBRE) Review Committee of the Chinese University of Hong Kong (SBRE-23-0249).
We appreciate your participation.
Project Leader Contact Information and Organization:
Project Leader: Professor Catherine Wing-Chee So
Tel: 3943-3036

From: New Asia College

nac@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
太極入門班
我們誠邀大家參與由新亞書院文化委員會主辦，並獲田家炳基金會贊助「太極入門班」。本課程由新亞校友、現為香港武術隊成員歐陽佩妤擔任導師，旨在讓參加者認識太極拳的基本原理與養生概念，透過練習提升身心健康，並促進友好社群交流。詳情如下：
導師：
歐陽佩妤（香港武術隊成員）
日期：
2026年9月24日至12月3 日(逢星期四，除了10月1日及11月12 日，共九堂)
時間：
19:00 – 20:30
地點：
新亞書院梅雲堂 – 許國浩堂 (
見位置圖
)
對象：
中大本科生及教職員（新亞學生及教職員優先）
費用：
HK$200 (完成8成出席率之學員可獲退還)
授課語言：
中、英語 (所有口令、招式名稱將以中文為主，並輔以英文解釋。確保所有學員理解動作細節。)
課程目標：
了解太極拳的基本原理與養生概念
學習並掌握太極拳的基礎功法和步法。
透過練習促進身心放鬆、改善身體協調性與平衡感。
提供一個輕鬆、友好的社群互動機會。
網上報名
(2026年9月18日截止)
：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13739700

查詢：
39437609 /
nac@cuhk.edu.hk
Tai Chi Introductory Course
We are pleased to invite you to join the Tai Chi Introductory Course, organized by the Committee on College Culture of New Asia College, with sponsorship from the Tin Ka Ping Foundation. This course will be taught by Miss Pearly Au-Yeung, an alumna of New Asia College and a current member of the Hong Kong Wushu Team. It aims to help participants understand the basic principles and health concepts of Tai Chi Chuan, enhance physical and mental well-being through practice, and promote friendly community interaction. Details are as follows:
Course Instructor:
Miss Pearly Au-Yeung (Current member of the Hong Kong Wushu Team)
Date:
24 September to 3 December 2026 (Every Thursday, except 1 October and 12 November, 9 sessions in total)
Time:
19:00 – 20:30
Venue:
Hui Kwok Hau Hall, Mei Yun Tang, New Asia College (
see location map
)
Participants:
CUHK undergraduates and staff members (priority for NA students and staff)
Fee:
HK$200 (refundable upon achieving at least 80% attendance)
Language:
Chinese and English (Commands and movement names will be given primarily in Chinese, with English explanations. The instructor will ensure all participants understand the details.)
Course Objectives:
Understand the basic principles and health concepts of Tai Chi Chuan.
Learn and master basic Tai Chi techniques and footwork.
Promote physical and mental relaxation, and improve body coordination and balance through practice.
Provide a relaxed and friendly opportunity for community interaction.

What will happen when Social Science meets Computer Science? Can social scientists benefit from computer science research?

Computational Social Science Laboratory (CSSL@CUHK)
,
“

18 September 2026 (Friday)

University of Michigan
Venue:

Google Map

poster
.

csspfs@cuhk.edu.hk
. Thank you.
About CSSL@CUHK
Large amounts of data are now being produced, collected, and analysed at unprecedented speed, breadth, depth, and scale. Focusing on the development and application of computational methods for complex and large-scale human behavior and behavioral change, Computational Social Science addresses fundamental questions about individuals and collectives, and major social problems. With the aim to promote interdisciplinary collaborations in addressing substantive social science questions, the
CSSL@CUHK
was formed in April 2021.

sign up
to receive the latest news and information from CSSL@CUHK.

Each Computational Social Science Concentration student is affiliated with a department/school/programme within the Faculty of Social Science. The scheme aims to bring together young talents from different disciplines who aspire to employ solution-based CSS approaches to address important and complex problems.

BESGO FoundRise Entrepreneurship Training
:
Effective Communication and Pitching
Got an idea but unsure how to present it effectively to investors? Want to learn how to pitch like a founder?
BESGO FoundRise is organising an entrepreneurship training session for CUHK students interested in entrepreneurship, startup development, business communication, and pitching.

Date:
29 September 2026 (Tuesday)
⏰
Time:
19:00 – 21:00

Venue:
ELB Room308

Registration:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13736333
Speaker: Jonathan WU
Founder and Managing Partner at Wings Capital Ventures (WCV). He holds a degree from the University of Michigan and built extensive experience across multiple financial institutions prior to launching his own fund. Drawing on his expertise in presentation, communication and pitching, he will share practical insights from a venture‑capital standpoint.
Through this training, participants will learn how to:
communicate business ideas clearly and professionally;
structure a compelling pitch;
present a value proposition and business model;
tailor messages to investors, mentors, partners, and potential customers; and
respond effectively to questions and feedback.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

創業培訓：有效溝通與演示技巧
有創業構思，但不確定如何向投資者有效展示項目？想掌握創業者簡報演示的核心要點？
BESGO FoundRise 將舉辦「有效溝通與演示技巧」創業培訓，歡迎對創業、初創發展、商業溝通及 簡報演示有興趣的中大學生參加。

日期：
2026年9月29日
⏰
時間：
18:45-20:00

地點：
ELB 308室

報名連結：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13736333
講者簡介：
Jonathan WU
, Wings Capital Ventures (WCV) 創辦人兼管理合夥人，密歇根大學畢業。在創立自身基金前，曾於多家金融機構累積豐富從業經驗。憑藉豐富的演示、溝通及簡報演示專業經驗，結合風投視角，為同學帶來實務分享。
透過本次培訓，參加者將學習如何：

有效回應提問及反饋。

From: SUE GAO

【Introduction】: This research study, titled “Compensation of White Matter Pathways and Networks in Chinese Children with Developmental Dyslexia in Hong Kong,” is led by Prof. Jingjing Zhao from the Department of Psychology at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
【Description of the study】: The purpose of this study is to explore how white matter pathways in the brain may compensate for reading difficulties in Chinese-speaking children with developmental dyslexia in Hong Kong.
【Study Procedures】 ● Reading and Cognitive Assessments: Your child will participate in reading and cognitive assessments lasting approximately 30–40 minutes. You are not required to complete any of these tasks. ● Brain Imaging (MRI Scan): Your child will also undergo a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan lasting about 20 minutes. The MRI procedure is non-invasive, painless, radiation-free, and no sedation. Please inform the research team in advance if your child has claustrophobia, metal implants, or a pacemaker.
Target participants: Children aged 8–16 years, whose parents are native Mandarin or Cantonese speakers, are eligible to participate.
【Data Confidentiality and Usage】:All data will be handled in accordance with data protection and privacy regulations. All collected data will be anonymized and will not include identifiable information (e.g., name, ID number, contact details). Data will be used solely for academic research purposes.
針對多種神經發育學習障礙的閱讀困難跨診斷研究
現正招募：
8-16歲、廣東話為母語的兒童
（1） 正常發展或
（2）被診斷或懷疑有任何一項：
（i）自閉症
（ii）注意力缺陷
（iii）讀寫障礙
測試内容：
語言、記憶及認知能力測試
磁力共振掃描（MRI）
時間：2小时
地點：威爾士親王醫院（第一城）
合資格參與者完成所有測試後可獲得:
綜合語言能力評核報告
最高達$200 現金
兒童磁力共振影相電子版
神經指標分析報告

Announcements
CUHK "Mind Bathing" — Mindful Nature Connection Training Scheme 中大【心·淋浴】靜觀大自然連結嚮導培訓計劃 - Department of Educational Administration and Policy
From: Cheng Man Sze
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
1155235728@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【Mind Bathing 】Mindful Forest Bathing Guide Training Programme
This programme will guide students in a forest bathing experience at CUHK on 16 Dec 2026 (Wednesday) , enabling participants to learn how to connect body and mind through nature. Upon completion, participants will acquire the foundational skills to lead junior secondary students in forest bathing experiences, helping adolescents build psychological resilience and mindfulness in their school lives. CUHK students who meet the eligibility criteria are invited to participate in the training and to guide junior secondary students in forest bathing and mindfulness practices on the activity day.
Programme Overview
"Mind Bathing" aims to promote the application of forest bathing (Shinrin-yoku) and nature-based mindfulness in school settings. Through direct experience, participants will learn how to harness the natural environment to enhance physical and mental well-being, and apply these learnings in future educational or community service contexts.
Fee: Free of charge
Eligibility Criteria
Undergraduate or postgraduate student at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (all faculties welcome)
Interest in or basic knowledge of forest bathing, mindfulness, or nature-based healing
Able to attend the full forest bathing training session (14 Dec 2026, 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.) and at least two mindfulness workshops.
Able to attend the "Mind Bathing" activity on 16 Dec (2:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.) to guide junior secondary students in forest bathing
Proficient in Cantonese
Sense of responsibility and openness to learning
Interview Arrangements
Date: Mid of October  2026 (specific dates will be notified individually after registration)
Format: Zoom video interview (approximately 5–10 minutes)
Language: Primarily Cantonese
Training Components
1) "Mind Bathing" Guide Training Workshop
Date: 14 Dec 2026 (Monday)/15 Dec 2026(Tuesday ) (Backup)
Time: 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (4 hours)
Venue: CUHK campus (indoor and outdoor)
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
2) Mind-Body Connection Mindfulness Workshops
Each student guide must attend a minimum of two mindfulness workshops.
Dates:
Mindfulness Foundations: 3 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)
Cultivating Emotional Awareness: 10 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)
The Wisdom of the Heart: 17 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m.
Connecting with the World: 24 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m.
Venue: CUHK campus (Chung Chi campus), indoor and outdoor
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
3) "Mind Bathing" Junior Secondary Student Service
Date: 16 Dec 2026 (Wednesday)/17 Dec 2026(Thursday ) (Backup)
Time: 2:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (4 hours)
Venue: CUHK campus (indoor and outdoor)
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
Programme Content:
Walk along CUHK nature trails to experience forest bathing and connect with nature
Learn mindfulness attitudes and techniques to connect with the present moment
Acquire knowledge and practical applications of psychological resilience
Understand the basic concepts and practices of nature-based healing
Experience engaging with nature through the five senses (sight, hearing, smell, touch, taste)
Introduction to basic guiding techniques and considerations for leading group activities
Application Method: Applicants please fill in the form by 2026/10/7.
Form link:
https://reurl.cc/XxArn7
Programme Facilitators
Dr. Lau Ngar Sze
- Registered Secondary School Teacher
- Promoting mindfulness among undergraduate, pre-service, and in-service teachers since 2007
- Senior Lecturer, Department of Educational Administration and Policy, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Partner Organisation: Nature Bathing
- A social enterprise with a professional team of forest bathing guides
Specialises in delivering immersive nature-based experiences to help urban dwellers relieve stress
- Expert in guiding participants to connect with nature through the five senses for holistic healing
The event is organized by the student group ‘TEDxCUHK’ at CUHK, with the support of the Sustainable Development Goals Action Fund.
Important Notes
1）Participants are advised to wear comfortable clothing and sports shoes suitable for outdoor activities
2）In the event of inclement weather, a contingency date or indoor alternative activities will be arranged
3）Participants who complete the training and service will receive a certificate of attendance acknowledging their training and service hours
4）This programme is educational in nature and does not constitute clinical treatment
Enquiries
For any enquiries regarding this programme, please contact Ms. Cheng:
Email: 1155235728@link.cuhk.edu.hk
Programme Coordinators:
Dr. Lau Ngar Sze ; Mr. Wong Chun Kai; Ms. Wong Hiu Lam
Faculty of Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
We look forward to walking with you into the woods and experiencing the healing power of nature!
【心·淋浴 】靜觀森林浴嚮導培訓計劃
"Mind Bathing" — Mindful Forest Bathing Guide Training Scheme
本計劃將於2026年12月16日（三）帶領學生在中大進行森林浴體驗，讓參加者學習如何透過大自然連結身心，並在培訓後具備基本能力，帶領初中學生體驗森林浴，協助青少年在校園生活中建立心理韌性與靜觀能力。現邀請符合條件的中大學生進行培訓及於活動當日帶領初中生體驗森林浴及學習正念。
計劃簡介
「心·淋浴」計劃旨在推廣森林浴 (Shinrin-yoku) 及大自然靜觀在校園的應用。參加者將透過親身體驗，學習如何運用大自然環境促進身心靈健康，並將所學應用於未來的教育或社區服務場景。
費用： 全免
招募對象
- 香港中文大學本科生及研究生（就讀任何學科均可）
- 對森林浴、正念或大自然療癒有興趣或具備基本認識
- 能夠出席完整一節森林浴培訓（12月14日 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. 以及至少兩節正念工作坊
- 能出席12月16日下午1:00-5:00 的「心·淋浴」的活動，帶領初中學生體驗森林浴
- 能夠說利廣東話
- 具備責任心及開放態度
面試安排
日期： 2026年 10月中旬（具體日期將於報名後個別通知）
形式： Zoom 視像面試（約5-10分鐘）
語言： 廣東話為主
培訓內容
1） 「心·淋浴」嚮導培訓工作坊
日期： 2026年12月14日（一）/2026年12月15日（二）（後備）
時間： 1:00 p.m.  -  5:00 p.m.（共4小時）
地點： 香港中文大學校園（戶外及室內結合）
語言： 廣東話為主，英語輔助
2） 心身連結正念工作坊
每位學生嚮導最少要參加兩節正念體驗工作坊。
日期：
-  正念基礎  2026年11月3日（二）12:30 pm to 2:00 pm (必須出席)

【Mind Bathing 】Mindful Forest Bathing Guide Training Programme
This programme will guide students in a forest bathing experience at CUHK on 16 Dec 2026 (Wednesday) , enabling participants to learn how to connect body and mind through nature. Upon completion, participants will acquire the foundational skills to lead junior secondary students in forest bathing experiences, helping adolescents build psychological resilience and mindfulness in their school lives. CUHK students who meet the eligibility criteria are invited to participate in the training and to guide junior secondary students in forest bathing and mindfulness practices on the activity day.
Programme Overview
"Mind Bathing" aims to promote the application of forest bathing (Shinrin-yoku) and nature-based mindfulness in school settings. Through direct experience, participants will learn how to harness the natural environment to enhance physical and mental well-being, and apply these learnings in future educational or community service contexts.
Fee: Free of charge
Eligibility Criteria
Undergraduate or postgraduate student at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (all faculties welcome)
Interest in or basic knowledge of forest bathing, mindfulness, or nature-based healing
Able to attend the full forest bathing training session (14 Dec 2026, 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.) and at least two mindfulness workshops.

Proficient in Cantonese
Sense of responsibility and openness to learning

Venue: CUHK campus (indoor and outdoor)
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support

Mindfulness Foundations: 3 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)
Cultivating Emotional Awareness: 10 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)

Connecting with the World: 24 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m.
Venue: CUHK campus (Chung Chi campus), indoor and outdoor

Walk along CUHK nature trails to experience forest bathing and connect with nature
Learn mindfulness attitudes and techniques to connect with the present moment
Acquire knowledge and practical applications of psychological resilience

From: Czarina Tong

[誠邀自閉人士] 從腦力多元角度認識自閉人士的觀點 - 質性訪談 ദ്ദി •⩊• )
您願意分享您的生活經驗與看法嗎？我們誠意邀請您參與一項有關自閉人士自我覺察與污名經驗的質性訪談研究，幫助我們更深入了解自閉人士的身份認同，以及應對污名的方式。
完成訪談後，參加者可獲得 港幣一百元 作為酬謝（可透過 PayMe / FPS / 銀行過數發 放）。
參加條件：
曾被確診或自認為自閉人士
能用廣東話交流
年滿十八歲
研究過程：
按以下連結登記及完成首份問卷（約10分鐘）
部分參與者會被邀請進行一次性面對面訪談（過程約 60-90 分鐘），探討個人自我覺察、污名經驗及應對態度
有效完成訪談後，填寫研究答謝金確認書，並領取港幣 $100 酬謝金
如符合以上參加條件並有興趣參與研究，請透過以下連結報名：
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfCm4IGDtggwrbgLSoY0kBLKSf3fQmTwxr31PtIUYB5Kvld5g/viewform
本研究由香港中文大學臨床心理學碩士研究生（趙胤程、徐瑋彤、萬麗雲）執行，並由心理學系麥穎思教授督導。所有收集所得的資料將絕對保密並僅作研究用途。
如對是項研究有任何疑問或查詢，歡迎聯絡研究團隊 （趙胤程 erikpersson@link.cuhk.edu.hk, 徐瑋彤 iristsui1124@link.cuhk.edu.hk, 萬麗雲 phoebeman@link.cuhk.edu.hk。
感謝！
[Invitation for Autistic Individuals] Understanding Autistic Perspectives from a Neurodiversity Lens - Qualitative Interview ദ്ദി •⩊• )
Would you be willing to share your life experiences and perspectives? We would like to invite you to participate in a qualitative interview study on self-awareness and stigmatised experiences among autistic individuals, helping us gain a deeper understanding of your autistic identity and coping strategies!
Upon completing the interview, participants will receive HKD 100 as a token of appreciation (payable via PayMe / FPS / Bank Transfer).
Eligibility Criteria:
Diagnosed with autism or self-identified as autistic
Able to communicate in Cantonese
Aged 18 or above
Research Process:
Click the link below to register and complete an initial questionnaire (approx. 10 minutes).
Selected participants will be invited to a one-time face-to-face/zoom interview (approx. 60–90 minutes) exploring personal self-awareness, stigmatized experiences, and coping attitudes.
Upon successful completion of the interview, you would complete a confirmation form to receive the HKD $100 compensation.
If you meet the above eligibility criteria and are interested in participating, please register via the following link:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfCm4IGDtggwrbgLSoY0kBLKSf3fQmTwxr31PtIUYB5Kvld5g/viewform
This study is conducted by Master of Social Sciences in Clinical Psychology students at CUHK (Persson Erik Yan Ching, Iris Tsui Wai Tung, and Man Lai Wan Phoebe), under the supervision of Professor Winnie Mak from the Department of Psychology. All collected data will be kept strictly confidential and used solely for research purposes.
If you have any questions or inquiries about this study, please feel free to contact the research team:
Erik Persson: erikpersson@link.cuhk.edu.hk
Iris Tsui: iristsui1124@link.cuhk.edu.hk
Phoebe Man: phoebeman@link.cuhk.edu.hk

Invitation to ICS Public Lecture – Dr. Jennifer Dorothy Lee on 24 September 2026 誠邀參加中國文化研究所訪問學人公開講座──李晉美博士（芝加哥藝術學院） - Institute of Chinese Studies
From: Amber Lam
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ics-activities@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
You are cordially invited to attend a public lecture organised by the Institute of Chinese Studies (ICS) at The Chinese University of Hong Kong on Thursday, 24 September 2026. It is our honour to welcome Dr. Jennifer Dorothy LEE, ICS Visiting Fellowship visiting scholar from the School of the Art Institute of Chicago, to deliver a talk on the topic:
“Shuttered Eyes, Kinship Threads: Tracing Music and Migration in the Family of Yo-Yo Ma”
.
Abstract:
What can a single photograph say? The black-and-white artefact featured in this talk, a product of the Nanjing Guanghua Photo Studio, shows a family like many others in 1946, caught between wars and continents. The figures pictured are musicians, primarily, but also teachers, scientists, and jacks-of-all-trades. They are the progenitors of the famed cellist Yo-Yo Ma, of his sister Yeou-Cheng, and of me. Drawing on lenses that range from music to art history to something akin to critical fabulation, I unfold the episodic, recursive process of unearthing my family history for the very first time. The process starts from initial encounters with a single photograph that cue a forensic exploration, compelling me to extract from handwritten letters, intimate anecdotes, musical manuscripts, and persistent memories. At certain points, through an historian's microscope, I reconstruct the spaces in which these familial figures lived and breathed. At other points, I activate imaginative techniques, such as the musical notations they leave behind, to piece together the facts and fabulations of the past.
Speaker:
Dr. Jennifer Dorothy Lee
is Associate Professor of Art History, Theory, & Criticism at the School of the Art Institute of Chicago. Trained in comparative literature, Lee brings literary frames and methodologies to work with visual and material objects. Lee's first book,
Anxiety Aesthetics: Maoist Legacies in China, 1978–1985
(University of California Press, 2024) offers a sustained study of aesthetics, art, and subjectivity redefined in the historical moment bridging the Mao era with Dengist reforms. Lee's current book project,
Diasporic Longing
, explores belonging, displacement, and music from Asia to Europe among her family of musicians. Tracking her progenitors' wartime migrations amid 20th-century upheavals, Lee weaves biography, storytelling, fragments of poetry, and musical notation to revisit the meanings of diaspora across three continents. Lee holds a PhD in East Asian Studies from New York University, an MA in Comparative Literature from the University of London, and a BA in English & Comparative Literature from Columbia University.

[Recruiting Older Adult Caregivers] Effects of mindfulness-based intervention on the microbiome of older adult with chronic stress: A randomised controlled trial (Earn up to $300 supermarket vouchers )  【誠招年長照顧者】靜觀課程對有慢性壓力的長者的微生物群成效研究 (完成最高獲$300現金券) - SPHPC
From: Donald Liu
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
donaldliu@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
靜觀課程對有慢性壓力的長者的微生物群成效研究: 隨機對照試驗
Effects of mindfulness-based training on the microbiome of older adults with chronic stress: A randomised controlled trial
現正誠邀合資格人士報名參加
We are now recruiting participants to join our programme.
賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院 現誠邀60歲以上人士參加一項靜觀課程研究
研究將會探討靜觀課程對有慢性壓力的長者的微生物群的影響。
很多長者受慢性壓力困擾，如未能適當處理壓力，對他們的心理及生理皆有嚴重影響。研究發現慢性壓力會破壞腸道微生物群的平衡。靜觀證實可有效改善心理健康，卻甚少研究探究靜觀課程如何改善參與者的微生物群。這項研究將在社區招募138名年滿60歲人士，邀請他們參與為長者而設的靜觀課程與健康教育控制課程，比較兩者於改善壓力、負面情緒及腸道微生物的成效。
參加者將會被隨機分派入兩組其中一組：
a) 靜觀練習組：
分派入本組的參加者將接受為期八周，每週一次，每次大約一小時三十分鐘的靜觀課程。每堂靜課程將會錄音，以作審視課程的保真度。
b) 健康教育組：
分派入本組的參加者會接受為期八周，每週一次，每次大約一小時三十分鐘的健康教育課程，課程內容包括營養，運動，維持生活習慣。每堂靜課程將會錄音，以作審視課程的保真度。
招募對象:
i) 年齡60歲以上;
ii) 能聽講廣東話;
iii) 需要持續照顧有長期病患的親屬;
iv) 照顧者負荷指數達 7分或以上;
v)沒有經醫生診斷有精神病患或認知問題;
vi) 沒有嚴重的身體或精神問題;
vi)不是正接受心理治療;
vii) 兩年內沒有參加過正規的靜觀課程;
viii) 被照顧親屬並非剛離世;
ix) 三個月內沒有使用抗生素或益生菌
課堂詳情
時間：10月尾開始 星期三或四的 上午
地點：沙田瀝源健康院 - 本活動共8節, 每週1次, 每次1.5小時
兩組參加者均須在課程開始前、結束後，及結束後3個月填寫共次3問卷調查及提供3次糞便樣本。
*費用全免*
參與是次研究不需繳付任何費用。
每次提供樣本及填寫問卷將會獲得價值$100 的現金卷，最高可獲300元現金卷。
歡迎將以上資訊廣傳給親朋好友。
如需了解更多本研究資訊或查詢，請聯絡：
廖先生/魏先生 (研究助理)
電話：2252-8463  Whatsapp: 5264 6865
如有興趣參與研究，請使用以下連結報名。
報名：https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_8cu06nvBsZqwVBY

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:

From: Chu Choi Ying
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mpss@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The Chinese version follows the English version of this email.
Multicultural Psychological Support Service: Counselling Service for Non-Local Students
No matter where we come from, we all desire to express our emotional needs with no barrier. Speaking in our mother tongue with someone who shares our cultural background not only allows us to better articulate ourselves but also fosters a deeper sense of understanding.
In order to support CUHK non-local students, the Wellness and Counselling Centre (WACC) of the Office of Student Affairs (OSA) offers Multicultural Psychological Support Service. This service allows students to receive counselling services in a comfortable environment.
The service is provided by St John’s Cathedral Counselling Service, and it is available to all CUHK full-time non-local students. The counsellors from St John’s Cathedral Counselling Service are capable of providing counselling services in English or Putonghua, as well as other languages including English, Putonghua, French, German, Dutch, Spanish, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Portuguese, Korean, Urdu, Russian, Sindhi and Tagalog (subject to counsellor’s availability). Below are the specific details of the services provided:
Location:
St John’s Cathedral Counselling Service
Address:
10th Floor, Two Chinachem Plaza, 68 Connaught Road, Central
Website:
https://www.sjccs.hk/
Service Period:
July 2026 to June 2027
Opening hours:
9AM to 9PM Monday to Saturday, except on Public Holiday
Service Target:
All CUHK full-time non-local students, including exchange students.
Local students with extensive exposure to cultural experiences outside Hong Kong are also eligible (e.g. with international school backgrounds, or ethnic minorities born in Hong Kong).
Session:
6 counselling sessions
For more information about the Multicultural Psychological Support Service, please visit
OSA WACC website
or contact WACC staff at 3943 9951 or 3943 7208.
How can I make an appointment?
Enroll online by webform:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13733096
If you have an urgent need to see a counsellor, you may visit WACC during office hours. The Duty Counsellor will assess your needs and make appropriate arrangements with you. If you need emotional support during non-office hours, please call the CUHK 24-hour Emotional Support Hotline at 5400 2055 (exclusively for CUHK Full-time Students and Part-time PGDE Students).
Enquiries:
Contact number: 3943 9951/ 3943 7208
Email:
mpss@cuhk.edu.hk
/
wacc@cuhk.edu.hk
Best regards,
Multicultural Psychological Support Service (MPSS)
Wellness and Counselling Centre
Office of Student Affairs
3/F Pommerenke Student Centre, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shatin, N.T.
T: +852 3943 9951   E:
mpss@cuhk.edu.hk
多元文化心理支援服務
為非本地學生提供母語輔導服務
無論來自哪裡，我們都渴望輕鬆地表達感受。用母語與有相似文化背景的人交談，不僅讓我們能清楚表達自己，還可增強更深層次的理解。為支援非本地同學，學生事務處心理健康及輔導中心推出「多元文化心理支援服務」，讓同學可在舒服自在的情況下打開心扉。
輔導服務由中環聖約翰座堂輔導服務提供，服務對象為所有香港中文大學全日制非本地學生。輔導員除了能提供以英語或普通話為母語的輔導服務外，亦能以法語、德語、荷蘭語、西班牙語、印地語、印尼語、日語、葡萄牙語、韓語、烏爾都語、俄語、信德語和他加祿語等其他語言進行輔導。服務詳情如下：
服務提供者：
聖約翰座堂輔導服務中心
服務地址：
中環幹諾道中
68
號華懋廣場Ⅱ期
10
樓
網址：
https://www.sjccs.hk/
服務時段：
2026年7月至2027年六月
營業時間：
週一至週六上午 9 時至晚上 9 時，公眾假期除外
服務對象：
香港中文大學全日制非本地學生，包括交換生
本地學生如有豐富的非本地文化背景（如曾就讀國際學校，或在香港出生的少數族裔人士）亦可申請

From: Chu Choi Ying

The Chinese version follows the English version of this email.
Multicultural Psychological Support Service: Counselling Service for Non-Local Students
No matter where we come from, we all desire to express our emotional needs with no barrier. Speaking in our mother tongue with someone who shares our cultural background not only allows us to better articulate ourselves but also fosters a deeper sense of understanding.
In order to support CUHK non-local students, the Wellness and Counselling Centre (WACC) of the Office of Student Affairs (OSA) offers Multicultural Psychological Support Service. This service allows students to receive counselling services in a comfortable environment.
The service is provided by St John’s Cathedral Counselling Service, and it is available to all CUHK full-time non-local students. The counsellors from St John’s Cathedral Counselling Service are capable of providing counselling services in English or Putonghua, as well as other languages including English, Putonghua, French, German, Dutch, Spanish, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Portuguese, Korean, Urdu, Russian, Sindhi and Tagalog (subject to counsellor’s availability). Below are the specific details of the services provided:
Location:
St John’s Cathedral Counselling Service
Address:
10th Floor, Two Chinachem Plaza, 68 Connaught Road, Central
Website:
https://www.sjccs.hk/
Service Period:
July 2026 to June 2027
Opening hours:
9AM to 9PM Monday to Saturday, except on Public Holiday
Service Target:
All CUHK full-time non-local students, including exchange students.
Local students with extensive exposure to cultural experiences outside Hong Kong are also eligible (e.g. with international school backgrounds, or ethnic minorities born in Hong Kong).
Session:
6 counselling sessions
For more information about the Multicultural Psychological Support Service, please visit
OSA WACC website
or contact WACC staff at 3943 9951 or 3943 7208.
How can I make an appointment?
Enroll online by webform:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13733096
If you have an urgent need to see a counsellor, you may visit WACC during office hours. The Duty Counsellor will assess your needs and make appropriate arrangements with you. If you need emotional support during non-office hours, please call the CUHK 24-hour Emotional Support Hotline at 5400 2055 (exclusively for CUHK Full-time Students and Part-time PGDE Students).
Enquiries:
Contact number: 3943 9951/ 3943 7208
Email:
mpss@cuhk.edu.hk

wacc@cuhk.edu.hk

(Earn $700!!!) Recruiting adults aged 18–65 who have recovered from depression to participate in a study on depression recurrence (participants on medication are welcome if condition is medically stable) (獲得 $700!!!) 誠邀年齡介乎18歲至65歲的抑鬱症康復者參與預測抑鬱症復發相關的研究(歡迎仍在服藥但病情穩定者參加) - Department of Psychiatry
From: Phoebe Chan
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學精神科學系正進行一項研究，探討運用語音分析能否預測抑鬱症復發。現招募年齡介乎18歲至65歲的抑鬱症康復者參與研究。詳情如下：
我們誠邀符合以下條件的人士參與本次研究：
18歲至65歲的抑鬱症康復者
廣東話為母語
使用智慧型手機並可持續連接互聯網
接受本研究所使用的即時通訊應用程式的服務條款和隱私權政策
您需要做什麼？
接受臨床評估作為篩查
填寫問卷
連續
7
天
於指定的手機應用程式以語音方式記錄情緒狀態
一年後接受跟進臨床評估
完成整個實驗及跟進評估，可以獲得最多HK$700作為研究津貼
如有興趣參與研究，請按以下連結填寫篩選問卷。
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_e9b0QXbpcuCUxrE
若您適合參與研究，研究人員會聯絡您解釋研究詳情。
閣下留下的資料僅供研究用途，絕對保密。如閣下對是項研究有任何查詢，請電郵
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
或 WhatsApp:(+852- 53202853)。
If you are interested, please complete the following screening questionnaire.
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_e9b0QXbpcuCUxrE
If you are suitable for participating in the study, the researchers will contact you to explain the study details.
Information collected will be only used for research purposes and will be kept strictly confidential. If you have any enquiries, please contact us via email
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
or WhatsApp: (+852-53202853).

From: Phoebe Chan
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學精神科學系正進行一項研究，主要探討運用語音分析檢測青少年的憂鬱症狀。現招募年齡介乎18歲至24歲的青少年參與研究，歡迎所有健康人士、抑鬱和焦慮人士參加。詳情如下:
我們誠邀符合以下條件的人士參與本次研究：
18歲至24歲青少年,
除了抑鬱和焦慮外，沒有確診其他精神障礙
能說流利的廣東話
使用智慧型手機（附錄音機）並可持續存取互聯網
接受本研究所使用的即時通訊應用程式的服務條款和隱私權政策
您需要做什麼？
通過篩查訪談後，在手機
連續 7 天
使用指定的訊息應用程式
使用手機上的錄音功能進行數位語音錄音，包括（a）指定的段落閱讀和（b）引導音訊日記。
每天
早上
和
晚上
，在應用程式分別回答4個指導性問題
進行跟進訪談
完成實驗及跟進評估後，可以獲得$200現金津貼。
有興趣的參加者請按以下連結填寫問卷：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_801s3xAKvKm1Uma
研究員將通過WhatsApp聯絡合適的參加者，並詳細解釋研究內容。

bodyText:

Announcements
Opportunity for Psychology students  - Educational Psychology
From: Justina Chay
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
justina.chay@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
We are currently looking for student helpers to facilitate mental health interventions for local parents and students. You will gain hands-on experience in conducting surveys and psychological assessments. Logistical support may be needed occassionally.
Selection criteria:
Major in psychology or related disciplines
Highly motivated
Conscientious, organised, and good interpersonal skills
Proficiency in both written and spoken Chinese

週專家級運動指導與全面體檢！

港幣購物券）
體育運動科學系，香港中文大學
運動營養與體力活動實驗室
發件人：何文柯
如有任何問題，請聯繫：
wenke.he@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學體育運動科學系運動營養與體力活動實驗室
誠邀您參加一項運動幹預研究!本研究將有助於瞭解您的運動代謝表現並提高您的代謝健康。
研究題目
：比較不同有氧運動訓練對超重或肥胖絕經後女性代謝及循環血液指標影響的隨機對照試驗
親愛的女士：
您好！
隨着年齡增長與絕經後的荷爾蒙變化，您是否覺得體重逐漸增加、脂肪容易囤積，或者開始擔心體脂、血脂等健康指標？香港中文大學體育運動科學系目前正開展一項研究以了解不同有氧運動訓練對絕經後超重或肥胖女性代謝健康的影響。我們誠邀符合條件的華人女性參與，一起通過科學運動重拾健康！
參與本研究，您將免費獲得：
1. 全面身體成分評估：精準檢測體脂率、肌肉量、內臟脂肪等。
2. 專業血液指標檢測：了解您的血脂、血糖等核心代謝指標。
3. 專家級運動能力測試：精準測量您專屬的運動代謝表現，以評估您的體能與代謝反應。
4. 為期 12 週的免費運動指導：由專業研究人員全程跟進，保障運動安全與效果。

我們在尋找這樣的您：
華人女性，且已自然絕經 12 個月或以上（距離最後一次月經少於 6 年）。
體型偏胖（BMI ≥ 23 kg/m² 或 體脂率 > 30%，以實驗室測試為準）。
平時運動較少（每星期少於 150 分鐘中等強度體能活動、少於 75 分鐘劇烈強度體能活動，或二者同等組合）。
過去 3 個月體重相對穩定，且無嚴重運動禁忌（如嚴重心臟病、中風等）。
⏳
您需要做什麼？（
3
次評估
+ 12
周幹預訓練）
本研究為期 12 週，合格者將隨機分配至對照組、有氧運動組A、有氧運動組B，期間需前往香港中文大學實驗室進行 3 次評估，具體包括：問卷調查、空腹靜脈抽血檢測、指尖採血、身體成分測量、運動代謝測試。為減少測試過程中的不適感，運動代謝測試將與其他健康測試分開進行，整個研究過程中，您總共需要到達實驗室
6
次。

3

40-70
分鐘，共
12
週

150

辦公室）

如有任何疑問，歡迎聯絡研究團隊：
研究負責人：何女士            (WhatsApp: +852 5984 8824)
指導教授：王香生 教授 (香港中文大學體育運動科學系)
祝您身體健康！

Invitation to Participate in CUHK Health Study: Free 12-Week Exercise Guidance and
Comprehensive Health Check!
(Complete the trial and receive a HK$150 shopping voucher)
Department of Sports Science and Physical Education
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Exercise Nutrition and Physical Activity Laboratory
Sender: He Wenke
For any questions, please contact:
wenke.he@link.cuhk.edu.hk
The Department of Sports Science and Physical Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong,
Exercise Nutrition and Physical Activity Laboratory,
sincerely invites you to participate in an exercise intervention study! This study will help us understand your exercise metabolic performance and improve your metabolic health.
Study Title
: A Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing the Effects of Different Aerobic Exercise Training on Metabolic and Circulating Blood Indicators in Overweight or Obese Postmenopausal Women
Dear Madam:
With aging and postmenopausal hormonal changes, do you feel that your weight is gradually increasing, fat is easily accumulated, or you begin to worry about health indicators such as body fat and blood lipids? The Department of Sports Science and Physical Education at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is currently conducting a study to understand the effects of different aerobic exercise training on metabolic health in overweight or obese postmenopausal women. We sincerely invite eligible Chinese women to participate and regain health together through scientific exercise!
By participating in this study, you will receive for free:
1. Comprehensive body composition assessment: accurate measurement of body fat percentage, muscle mass, visceral fat, etc.
2. Professional blood indicator testing: understand your core metabolic indicators such as blood lipids and blood glucose.
3. Expert-level exercise capacity test: accurately measure your exercise metabolic performance to evaluate your physical fitness and metabolic response.
4. 12 weeks of free exercise guidance: full follow‑up by professional researchers to ensure exercise safety and effectiveness.
We are looking for:
1. Chinese women who have been naturally postmenopausal for 12 months or more (less than 6 years since the last menstrual period).
2. Are overweight or obese (BMI ≥ 23 kg/m² or body fat percentage > 30%; will be confirmed by laboratory testing).
3. Are usually physically inactive (less than 150 minutes of moderate‑intensity physical activity, less than 75 minutes of vigorous‑intensity physical activity per week, or an equivalent combination).
4. Have had relatively stable body weight in the past 3 months, and have no serious contraindications to exercise (e.g., severe heart disease, stroke, etc.).
⏳ What do you need to do? (3 assessments + 12‑week intervention training)
This study lasts 12 weeks. Eligible participants will be randomly assigned to a
control group
,
aerobic
exercise group A,
or
aerobic exercise group B
. During the period, you will need to visit the laboratory at The Chinese University of Hong Kong for 3 assessments, including: questionnaire surveys, fasting venous blood draw, finger‑prick blood sampling, body composition measurement, and exercise metabolic testing. To reduce discomfort during testing, the exercise metabolic test will be conducted separately from other health tests. Throughout the study, you will need to come to the laboratory
6 times.
12‑week intervention training: 3 times per week, 40‑70 minutes each session, for 12 weeks.
Upon completion of the study, you will receive a HK$150 shopping voucher and a health report.
Trial location: G02 Office, Ground Floor, Kwok Sports Building, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Register now / Enquire:
Places are limited, first‑come, first‑served! You can click the link below to register:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfZKjSc55Ov13iAjw_GAGkFIbINsXc9rH1ePEYg6CWrU5w5Ew/viewform?usp=header
If you have any questions, please contact the research team:
Study coordinator: Ms. He (WhatsApp: +852 5984 8824)
Supervising professor: Professor Wang Xiangsheng (Department of Sports Science and Physical Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong)
Wishing you good health!
Research Team
Department of Sports Science and Physical Education
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Respectfully

研究目的：
研發一份專屬漢語母語者群體的閱讀能力評估量表。
招募對象：

Announcements
Recruitment of Part-time Teaching Assistant (Student Helper) for the Program for the Gifted and Talented, CUHK (Hourly Rate: $90) 香港中文大學教育學院「資優計劃」招募兼職助教（學生助理；時薪$90） - Faculty of Education
From: Program for the Gifted and Talented
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
pgt.admin@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學教育學院「資優計劃」招募兼職助教（學生助理）
香港中文大學教育學院「資優計劃」(PGT)定期舉辦春季、暑期及冬季資優課程，供小三至中六的資優學生參加。「資優計劃」現邀請主修相關學科的本科生或研究生擔任兼職助教，協助導師教學和支援學生學習。助教工作包括：跟進學生出席紀錄、分發課堂物資、支援學生學習、維持課堂秩序、留意學生學習進度、為缺席或有疑問的學生解釋課堂內容、策劃和組織活動、透過「資優計劃」社交平台協助內容創作與排版等。
有意擔任「資優計劃」助教的本科生或研究生，請於
2026
年
9
月
28
日
（星期一）
或之前前往
https://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/pgt/TA/recruitment
填寫網上報名表，並上載相關文件（個人履歷表、學歷證明文件副本（如香港中學文憑試證書）等）。
申請人必須出席面試，成功通過面試的助教須出席相關培訓，藉此認識「資優計劃」的教育理念、資優生特質、以及處理課堂突發事情的技巧等。面試及培訓均在香港中文大學校園內舉辦，並以粵語進行。有關詳情請參閲海報或瀏覽
https://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/pgt/_Doc/TA_Recruitment/Leaflet_JoinTA.pdf
。
如有任何查詢，歡迎致電 2603-7444 / 2603-7485 與本計劃聯絡。
Recruitment of Part-time Teaching Assistant (Student Helper) for the Program for the Gifted and Talented, CUHK
The Program for the Gifted and Talented (PGT) at the Faculty of Education, CUHK, regularly offers Spring, Summer, and Winter enrichment programs for gifted students ranging from Primary 3 to Secondary 6. PGT is now inviting undergraduate or postgraduate students majoring in relevant disciplines to serve as part-time Teaching Assistants, supporting instructors’ teaching and assisting students’ learning. Teaching Assistant duties include taking attendance, distributing learning materials in class, facilitating students’ learning, classroom management, monitoring students’ learning progress, explaining lesson content to students in need or those with questions, planning and organising program events, assisting with promotion via PGT’s social media platforms, etc.
Undergraduate and postgraduate students who are interested in becoming Teaching Assistants for the Program for the Gifted and Talented are invited to complete the online application form at
https://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/pgt/TA/recruitment
and submit the required documents (Resume, Certificates of public examination results, etc.) by
28 September 2026 (Mon
).
Applicants must attend an interview. Successful candidates will be required to participate in a training session designed to enhance their understanding of the Program, the characteristics of gifted students, and classroom management techniques. Both the interview and the training will be conducted in Cantonese and held on the CUHK campus. Please refer to the attached Poster or visit
https://www.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/pgt/_Doc/TA_Recruitment/Leaflet_JoinTA.pdf
for details.
If you have any enquiries, please contact us at 2603-7444 or 2603-7485.

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

bodyText:

Announcements
Participants Needed for Chinese Word Rating Experiment (HK$60) 招募中文詞彙評分實驗參與者（報酬：港幣 $60) - Psychology
From: Yuxi Chen
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
1155187064@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Chinese Version
我們正進行一項關於中文詞彙的線上研究，現誠邀符合條件的人士參與。
實驗詳情
• 內容： 透過線上問卷（Qualtrics）對一系列中文雙字詞的詞彙特性進行評分。
• 所需時間： 約 45 至 50 分鐘（問卷不設時間限制，可按個人節奏完成）。
• 報酬： 完成問卷後可獲港幣 $60。
參加條件
• 年滿 18 歲或以上
• 以中文（粵語或普通話）為母語
• 能流利閱讀繁體中文
• 視力正常（或經矯正後正常），且無閱讀障礙
報名方式
如您有興趣參與並符合上述條件，請透過以下連結填寫報名表：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4PK0MOXXYZDtlki
聯繫方式
研究員：陳昱熹先生 (yuxichen@link.cuhk.edu.hk)
首席研究員：Urs MAURER教授 (umaurer@cuhk.edu.hk)
語言認知神經科學實驗室
心理學系
本研究已獲香港中文大學–新界東醫院聯網臨床研究倫理聯席委員會審批（CUHK-NTEC CREC 2021.237）
English Version
Are you interested in participating in a linguistics/psychology research study? We are looking for eligible native Chinese speakers to complete an online study on Chinese compound words.
Experiment Details
Task: Rate lexical properties of a series of two-character Chinese compound words via an online questionnaire (Qualtrics).
Duration: Approximately 45–50 minutes (untimed; you can complete it at your own pace).
Compensation: HK$60 upon successful completion.
Eligibility Criteria
Age 18 or above
Native speaker of Chinese (Cantonese or Mandarin)
Able to read Traditional Chinese fluently
Normal or corrected-to-normal vision and no reading difficulties
How to Participate
If you are interested and meet the criteria above, please fill in the sign-up form at:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4PK0MOXXYZDtlki
Contact Information
Researcher: Mr. Yuxi CHEN (yuxichen@link.cuhk.edu.hk)
PI: Prof. Urs MAURER (umaurer@cuhk.edu.hk)
Cognitive Neuroscience of Language Laboratory
Department of Psychology
This study has been approved by the Joint Chinese University of Hong Kong-New Territories East Cluster Clinical Research Ethics Committee (CUHK-NTEC CREC 2021.237)
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.

【Register Now】International Summit on Pain Research - A CUHK and CUHK-Shenzhen Joint Forum (15 October 2026)  - Peter Hung Pain Research Institute
From: Peter Hung Pain Research Institute
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
phpainresearch@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear all,
We cordially invite you to attend our upcoming
International Summit on Pain Research -
A CUHK and CUHK-Shenzhen Joint Forum
on
15 October 2026 (Thursday)
at Lecture Theatre 2, G/F, Yasumoto International Academic Park (YIA).
Featuring renowned speakers from the US, UK and Mainland China, the forum will delve into circuit mapping, neural mechanisms, and novel therapeutic opportunities in pain research.
In addition, emerging young researchers will share their latest findings and showcase cutting-edge translational research spanning microglial priming, hydrogel brain interfaces, and VR pain therapies.
For more details on the programme and speakers, please visit our website:
https://www.phpri.cuhk.edu.hk/news/peter_hung_pain_research_institute_international_summit_on_pain_research_cuhk_and_cuhk-shenzhen_joint_forum.html
CME/ CPD Accreditation:
The Hong Kong College of Anaesthesiologists (HKCA) – 3 points
Hong Kong College of Physicians (HKCP) – pending
Registration
:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13738815
Should you have any questions or require further details, please do not hesitate to contact us.
We look forward to seeing you at the forum. Thank you!
Best regards,
Peter Hung Pain Research Institute
Faculty of Medicine
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
_________________________________________________
Tel: (852) 3505 1913   Email:
phpainresearch@cuhk.edu.hk
Website:
https://www.phpri.cuhk.edu.hk/
Address: 4/F, Main Clinical Block and Trauma Centre, Prince of Wales Hospital, Shatin, N.T. Hong Kong
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

/weekly/

title: WS Karate Regular Course - T1, 2026-27 和聲空手道正規課程 (2026/27年度上學期)
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/11
»
Announcements
WS Karate Regular Course - T1, 2026-27 和聲空手道正規課程 (2026/27年度上學期) - Lee Woo Sing College
From: Fung Hoi Kuen
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
henryfung@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你會否對日本武術和空手道均有興趣？又或是你本身已經「好打得」，想再更進一步？各位「和聲人」就千萬不要錯過，由2026 年9 月至11 月期間，由和聲書院舉辦的空手道正規課程啦！為切合不同程度的學員需要，課程更分設了初階及進階班予學員選擇。大家可以用非常優惠的價錢，跟隨前港隊空手道運動員鑽研空手道技術，課程完成後更可以考帶「升呢」。關於課程的詳情及報名方式，請參閱以下資料：
日期：
2026 年9 月至11 月，共10 堂
（9 月：18 ；10 月：2, 9, 16, 23, 30; 11 月：6, 13, 20, 27 ）
時間：
初階 ( 白帶&黃帶): 11:30 am – 1:00 pm
進階 ( 綠帶及以上): 11:30 am – 1:30 pm
場地：
和聲書院低座一樓胡定旭演講室
課程費用：
$800
8 成出席率可獲退款
和聲書院學生退款 - $300
中大學生、職員及和聲書院校友退款 - $200
* 學員需穿著空手道袍、拳套及道袍腰帶上課，相關物品可在報名表格中選購
** 學員可在最後一課，向導師提出參加考核，考核將於課程完結後舉行
其他費用：
空手道袍和白帶 ( 必需裝備)
和聲書院學生- $200
中大學生、職員及和聲書院校友 - $300
拳套 ( 必需裝備) - $200
腳套 ( 可選) - $ 300
考試費- 可選；須獲導師認可參與考核，將於課程結束後公佈
名額：
20
導師：
馬文心女士 (Margo)
l   前空手道精英運動員2007-2022
l   最高世界排名4
l   世界超級聯賽分站銀牌
l   亞洲賽銅牌
l   東亞運動會金牌
l   香港10 年搏擊冠軍
l   中國香港空手道總會3 級教練
l   香港中文大學空手道校隊教練
l   空手道黑帶4 段
付款方式：
請透過下列方法繳費 ( 連同道袍、白帶、拳套及腳套費用) ：
網上銀行轉賬：轉賬後截圖付款紀錄，並上載至報名表格。   截圖上須清晰列明中大賬戶號碼、交易參考編號及日期
中大賬戶號碼: 293-005005-018 (HSB)
賬戶名稱: The Chinese University of Hong Kong ／香港中文大學
*** 參加者必需於第一堂開課前繳交全部費用
備註：
學員需自備毛巾及水瓶上課。
學員應協助導師進行場地設置及還原工作。
有興趣參與空手道課程的學員，請在9 月17 日前於
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737584
報名。學員將於截止後收到書院院務室電郵通知。
如有任何問題，歡迎聯絡書院院務室何先生 (3943 1398;
khho@cuhk.edu.hk
) 。
Would you like to engage in a martial art sport through continuous practice at CUHK campus? Lee Woo Sing College now offers a REGULAR Karate training course between September and November 2026. You are going to study the skills and gain Kyu (rank qualification) under guidance of our professional trainer! All students with different levels, including beginners and experience players, are welcome to join our class with a favourable price.
Please note the course schedule below:
Date ：
Fridays from September to November 2026, 10 lessons available:
(Sep: 18 ; Oct: 2, 9, 16, 23, 30; Nov: 6, 13, 20, 27)
Time ：
Beginners (White & Yellow): 11:30 am – 1:00 pm
Advanced (Green & Above): 11:30 am – 1:30 pm
Venue ：
Anthony Wu Seminar Room, LG1/F, Lee Woo Sing College
Course Fee ：
HKD$800 (Karate Uniform Gi NOT included)
* Refund will be made to participants who reach 80% attendance:
Lee Woo Sing College students - HKD$300 refund
CUHK students / staff / WS Alumni - HKD$200 refund
Other Fees ：
Karate Uniform Gi plus White Belt (required)
$200 for LWS students
$300 for non-LWS students
Gloves (required) - $200
Foot Cover (optional) - $ 350
Examination Fee - optional; to be paid after instructor’s approval
No. of Participants (Max) ：
20
Instructor ：
Ms. MA Man Sum, Margo
l    Former Elite Karate Athlete 2007-2022
l    Highest World Ranking No. 4
l    World Premier League Silver
l    Asian Championship Bronze
l    East Asian Gold
l    National Champion 10 times
l    Certified Karate Coach level 3 & karate Referee
l    Karate Team Coach
l    Black Belt 4 Dan
Payment Method:
Please submit course fee (and uniform, belt and gloves, if any), to College Office via online payment transfer (e-banking):
After completion of payment, please save the screen capture as jpg/ png format, and attach to the WebForm . The payment record captured should include CUHK bank account no., transaction reference number and transaction date clearly
Account No.: 293-005005-018 (Hang Seng Bank)
Account Name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
*** Participants must settle the payment before the start of first lesson
Note to participants:
Participants should bring with own towels and bottled water to attend the classes.
Participants are advised to assist the instructor in venue set-up and restoration.
Interested parties please enroll at
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737584
before 17 September. Applicants will receive a notification email to confirm the place.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

From: BSc in Global Economics and Finance Programme

glef@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear CUHK non-final-year undergraduate students,
If you wish to apply to change your Major Programme to BSc in Global Economics and Finance (GLEF) in 27-28, please note that this ‘transfer-in’ application is on a competitive basis.
Academic Requirements
:
- Achieve good grades in at least 8 units from the following courses: DOTE1030 or ECON2011, DOTE1040 or ECON2021, ECON1101 or MATH1010/1510/1520, ECON1111.
- Other “equivalent” courses may be considered with discretion, such as FINA2310 for non-business students. However, DOTE1031, DOTE1035, ECON1010 are not accepted as substitutes for DOTE1030 or ECON2011.
- Year 1 applicants are prioritized while other applicants will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
Shortlisting Threshold
: Cumulative GPA 3.3 or above (up to 26-27 T1), on a selective basis
Admission Requirements
: Cumulative GPA 3.5 or above (up to 26-27 T2) and strong interview performance, on a selective basis
Application Period
: 23 January (10am, Saturday) – 5 February (5pm, Friday), 2027 (HKT)
Application Method:
Submit online application form + submit supporting documents by email. Early submission is appreciated.
Interview Date
: During reading week (8-13 March 2027) (to be confirmed). Shortlisted applicants must attend the interview. No exceptions (e.g. Zoom interviews or any other forms of make-up interviews) will be granted.
Interview
F
ormat:
Face-to-face.
Other Details:
Refer to our website.
GLEF reserves the right to modify the information without prior notice. In the event of disputes, GLEF shall prevail. Always refer to our website for the most up-to-date and accurate information.
Best regards,
Global Economics and Finance Programme
Department of Economics & Department of Finance
https://cuhk.hk/glef

bodyText:

Announcements
Brief Guided Self-Help Training Programme for Eating Disorders and Self-Criticism 「饮食问题低强度心理治疗」诚邀普通话女性使用者 - Experimental Psychopathology and Psychotherapy Laboratory, Department of Psychology
From: Yanbin, XIE
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ybxie@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
招募参与者：饮食问题低强度心理治疗
香港中文大学临床心理科学实验室团队现正推行一项针对饮食失调问题人群的短期训练计划，诚邀符合资格的人士参与。
六周指导式自助练习，处理与情绪和自我的关系
探索自我批评的恶性循环
开启看待自我的新视角
香港中文大学校园内，全程免费
饮食失调问题很多时候并非只是一个关于食物、身材偏好或者意志力的问题，而关乎我们如何看待自己，以及如何处理和他人的关系。目前，针对饮食失调的治疗多采用认知行为取向，研究证实能有效控制非适应性饮食失调行为的出现。本计划是团队基于实证研究开发的新训练方案，采用社会情绪取向，聚焦于处理自己与他人的关系。本项目遵循阶梯式照护模式，定位为指导式自助短期介入方案，旨在以较少的时间投入及心理负担为参加者提供支援。
训练为期6周，包括「每周1次实体会面 + 自助练习 + 线上心理评估访谈及问卷」；训练完成后1个月及6个月进行跟进评估。
「招募要求」
年满18岁或以上；女性；普通话流利（训练将主要使用普通话）；
受饮食失调问题困扰，例如，对饮食失调、体重或体型有过度的关注，饮食失调后感到强烈自责或羞愧，反复出现无法控制的暴食行为，或伴有反复出现的代偿行为（催吐、使用泻药或利尿剂、过度运动等）并因此影响日常生活或情绪；
目前并未接受其他形式的心理治疗或精神科药物治疗；
能够亲身前往香港中文大学校园参与训练。
「报名链接」
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_0pJvKNUXXEGYx4G
报名后，我们将联络您安排筛选问卷及访谈，以确认是否适合参加本计划，并邀请符合条件者参与训练。
如有疑问请联络研究团队：epplab.ed@cuhk.edu.hk。
所有个人资料仅用作研究用途，并会严格保密。
临床心理科学实验室团队
Recruiting Participants: Brief Training Programme for Eating Disorders
The Experimental Psychopathology and Psychotherapy Laboratory at CUHK is currently running a brief training programme for individuals struggling with eating disorders. We are now inviting eligible participants to join.
We all care about how we look. But eating disorders are often about much more than food, body shape, or willpower—they are deeply tied to how we see ourselves and how we relate to others. While cognitive-behavioural therapy (CBT) is the most widely used and evidence-based treatment for eating disorders, our team has developed a new training protocol grounded in recent research, drawing on a socioemotional framework that focuses specifically on self-perception and interpersonal relationships. Following a stepped-care model, this programme is designed as a brief guided self-help intervention, offering meaningful support with a relatively low time commitment and psychological load.
  The programme runs for 6 weeks:
Weekly in-person sessions on campus
Guided self-help practice tasks to complete between sessions
Online assessment interviews and questionnaires
Follow-up evaluations will be conducted at 1 month and 6 months post-training.

Who We're Looking For
Female aged 18 or above;
Are fluent in Mandarin;
Are currently struggling with eating disorder symptoms, for example, excessive evaluation or concerns on food, weight, or body shape, intense guilt or shame after eating, recurrent episodes of binge eating that feel out of control, with compensatory behaviours such as self-induced vomiting, laxative or diuretic misuse, or excessive exercise;
Are not currently receiving any other form of psychological therapy or psychiatric medication;
Are able to attend in-person sessions on the CUHK campus

Sign Up Here
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_0pJvKNUXXEGYx4G
After you sign up, we will contact you to complete a screening questionnaire and a brief interview to see if this programme is a good fit for you. If eligible, you will be invited to join the 6-week training.
 For any questions, feel free to reach out to us at:
epplab.ed@cuhk.edu.hk
All information you provide will be kept strictly confidential and used solely for research screening and intervention purposes.
Experimental Psychopathology and Psychotherapy Laboratory

title: [Max. HKD$1⃣2⃣0⃣0⃣] Recruiting Native Cantonese-speaking Grandparents with hearing loss and Grandchildren for an Interaction Experiment [長者認知及聽力測試報告 + 兒童IQ智商測試報告] 招募聽力損失長者及其孫子女參與互動實驗
bodyText:

Announcements
[Max. HKD$1⃣2⃣0⃣0⃣] Recruiting Native Cantonese-speaking Grandparents with hearing loss and Grandchildren for an Interaction Experiment [長者認知及聽力測試報告 + 兒童IQ智商測試報告] 招募聽力損失長者及其孫子女參與互動實驗 - Brain and Mind Institute
From: LEUNG Mei Yee
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
我們是
香港中文大學大腦與認知研究所（BMI）
的研究團隊。我們團隊誠摯邀請有聽力損失的長者及其孫子女來參與一項互動研究。
參與者需符合以下條件：
長者：
65歲或以上，存在聽力損失，
無其他已知認知障礙症狀， 且有意願配戴助聽器
孩童：
6-9歲，
無其他已知發展問題，母語為廣東話
實驗內容：本實驗共分為兩節（每節約1.5至2小時）：
- 第一節：長者將獨自參與一項
認知及聽力檢測
（當日孫子女無需到場）
- 第二節：長者將與孫子女一同進行
簡單遊戲
，期間我們將使用安全且非侵入性的
「近紅外光譜儀」（fNIRS）
進行腦部掃描
- 請注意：參與者必須先完成第一節的實驗，且結果符合研究要求，方會獲邀參與第二節的實驗
完成整個實驗後，您可獲得：
- 長者：
一份認知能力測試報告
+
一份純音聽力測試報告
- 孩童：
一份非語言智商測試報告
+
一份價值HKD$80的禮物
報酬：現金
HKD$400-1200
，以及免費停車券（如適用）
實驗地點：香港中文大學大腦與認知研究所（位於校園內）
如您對本研究感興趣，請點擊以下連結填寫報名表格：
https://ci.cuhk.edu.hk/surveys/?s=LJEXMFLMR79XA7TX
如祖孫兩位初步符合條件，我們將會儘快與您聯絡！
如有疑問，請發送電郵至 meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk，
亦可致電或Whatsapp 95867123 查詢。
我們期待你的參與！
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We are researchers from the
Brain and Mind Institute (BMI) at the Chinese University of Hong Kong
. Our team sincerely invites grandparents with hearing loss and their grandchildren for a social interaction study.
Participants need to be:
- Grandparent:
65+ years old with hearing loss
, with no other diagnosed cognitive impairment, interested in fitting hearing aids
- Grandchild:
6-9 years old
with no other developmental problems; speaking Cantonese as the first language
What is involved? The experiment consists of two sessions (approx. 1.5-2 hours each):
- Session 1: The grandparent will participate alone in a
cognitive and hearing test
. (The grandchild does not need to attend)
- Session 2: The grandparent and grandchild will participate together in some
simple games
while using
fNIRS
(
functional near-infrared spectroscopy
, safe and non-invasive!!!) brain scanning device
- NOTE: Participants must first complete Session 1 and meet the study's requirements to be invited to Session 2
What you'll get (upon completion of the entire study):
- For the grandparent:
A cognitive test report
and
a pure-tone audiometry
(hearing test)
report
- For the child:
An non-verbal IQ test report
and
a gift (~HKD$80)
Reward:
HKD$400-1200
allowance
and free parking ticket.
Location: Brain and Mind Institute, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (In campus).
If you are interested in our study, please fill in the form below via the following link:
https://ci.cuhk.edu.hk/surveys/?s=LJEXMFLMR79XA7TX
We will contact you afterwards if the dyad are suitable.
For inquiries, please contact: meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk,
call or Whatsapp 95867123.
We look forward to your participation!
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Announcements
[Free of charge] [An allowance of up to HKD $1,000 will be provided upon successful enrollment] Recruitment of Diabetes Patients (Aged 18-80 years) for clinical trials of Chinese Medicine (Powder) Treatment 💰💰[費用全免] 📣[成功參與者可獲得高達港幣 $1,000 的津貼] 🙋🏻招募年齡介於 18-70 歲的糖尿病人士- 中藥(沖劑)治療臨床研究 - Department of Medicine and Therapeutics
From: Maggie Lee
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
maggielee@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
[
新中藥方劑治療
2
型糖尿病的臨床安全性、有效性和多組評價：對
β
細胞功能和胰島素抵抗的影響】
香港中文大學內科及藥物治療學系與香港中文大學香港中西醫結合醫學研究所現正聯合進行一項為期36週，以內服中藥(沖劑)治療 2 型糖尿病人
 研究對象：18至80歲華人
沒有重大疾病，沒有服用中藥， 身體質量指數 (BMI) ≥18 kg/m²  (公斤 ÷ 米 ÷ 米)
不吸煙或已戒煙至少 12 個月，如女性目前未懷孕
患糖尿病未滿 6 年，且在過去 3 個月內未使用任何降血糖藥物（包括胰島素）治療
至少具備以下其中一項風險因素:
糖尿病家族史 (尤其父母或兄弟姐妹在40歲前診斷 )
代謝綜合症 (3高：高血糖，高血壓，高膽固醇)
超重或肥胖
脂肪肝
多囊卵巢綜合症
妊娠糖尿病病史
如不確定自己是否患有糖尿病，會安排你服用葡萄糖飲料（75 克口服葡萄糖耐量試驗）
研究內容：中西醫評估、心電圖、肝纖維化掃描、抽血檢查、填寫問卷、服用研究中藥或安慰劑等
地點：新界沙田威爾斯醫院，舊座，3 樓，3M 病房 - 糖尿及內分泌研究中心
參與研究費用全免，成功參與者可獲得高達港幣 $1,000 的津貼，名額有限，先到先得！
閣下如對本研究有興趣請透過以下連結報名參加：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/mycuform/view.php?id=3542692
如果初步合適參與研究，負責同事將稍後聯絡你，謝謝
如對研究內容有任何疑問，歡迎致電  3505 3897 / 6937 3365 或 WhatsApp 6937 3365與負責研究人員聯絡、查詢詳情。
[Clinical safety, efficacy and multiomic evaluation of a novel Chinese Medicine formula in Type 2 diabetes: Effects on beta-cell function and insulin resistance
.]
Department of Medicine and Therapeutics and Hong Kong Institute of Integrative Medicine, CUHK are jointly conducting a 36-week clinical study on the use of oral traditional Chinese medicine (granule form) for treating type 2 diabetes.
Eligibility Criteria: Ethnic Chinese individuals aged 18 to 80 years
No major illnesses, not currently taking any traditional Chinese medicine, and with a Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 18 kg/m² (kg ÷ metre ÷ metre)
Non-smokers or those who have quit smoking for at least 12 months; females must not be currently pregnant
Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes for less than 6 years and have not used any glucose-lowering medications (including insulin) in the past 3 months
Must have at least one of the following risk factors:
Family history of diabetes (especially if parents or siblings were diagnosed before age of 40)
Metabolic syndrome (three highs: high blood sugar, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol)
Overweight or obesity
Fatty liver
Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)
History of gestational diabetes
If you are unsure whether you have diabetes, a 75g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) will be arranged for you.

Study Procedures Include:
Chinese and Western medical assessments, Electrocardiogram (ECG), Liver fibrosis scan, Blood tests, Questionnaire completion, Taking either the study Chinese medicine or a placebo
Location: Ward 3M, 3/F, Old Block, Diabetes and Endocrinology Research Centre, Prince of Wales Hospital, Sha Tin, New Territories
Free of charge to participate.
Successful participants may receive an allowance of up to HKD $1,000.
Limited quota – first come, first served!
Register via the following link:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/mycuform/view.php?id=3542692
If you are eligible based on initial assessment, our research team will contact you shortly. Thank you!
For inquiries, please contact:
3505 3897 / 6937 3365
WhatsApp: 6937 3365

/weekly/

bodyText:

2026/09/04
»
Announcements
⭐⭐[Student Helper Recruitment] Chinese Language and Culture Experience Activities | Cross-cultural Exchange 【學生助理招募】中國語言文化體驗活動｜跨文化交流 - Yale-China Chinese Language Academy
From: Yale-China Chinese Language Academy
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
CLA_UPD@CUHK.EDU.HK
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【學生助理招募】中國語言文化體驗活動｜跨文化交流
雅禮中國語文研習所將於本學期舉辦一系列面向國際學生的中國語言文化體驗活動，主題涵蓋漢字與書法、傳統節慶、手工文化體驗、中文詩歌與文化分享。現誠邀中大學生擔任學生助理，協助活動籌備與現場支援。
活動時間：逢星期五下午，每次兩小時，預計本學期共舉辦5至6次
活動地點：方潤華堂（東鐵線大學站D出口對面）
申請條件：
對跨文化交流充滿熱情，性格開朗，具備良好英語溝通能力，並能說標準普通話或粵語；
具備與中華文化相關的才藝，如書法、茶藝，並樂意與國際學生交流分享；
喜歡華語電影、戲劇配音；
了解中文歌曲和古詩詞；
熟悉Gen-AI工具、Vide-Coding等，能使用Kahoot設計小遊戲;
能協助外出、深圳的參觀和導賞工作；
會編製中國結或印章雕刻的學生獲優先考慮
[SL1]
待遇：時薪 HKD$67 + 5% MPF
總工作時數：約15小時
有意者請於9月21日前填妥以下表格，合則約見：

報名表格
如有疑問，請聯絡陳小姐：
liyuanchen@cuhk.edu.hk
[Student Helper Recruitment] Chinese Language and Culture Experience Activities | Cross-cultural Exchange
The Yale-China Chinese Language Academy will host a series of cultural workshops this semester for international students, focusing on themes in Chinese language and culture, including Chinese characters, calligraphy, traditional festivals, handicrafts, poetry, songs, and cultural sharing. We are now recruiting CUHK students to assist with planning and running these events.
Schedule: Friday afternoons, 2 hours per session, approximately 5–6 sessions throughout the semester
Venue: Fong Yun Wah Hall (opposite University Station Exit D)
Requirements:
Passionate about cross-cultural communication, outgoing, fluent in English, and able to speak Putonghua or Cantonese;
Possess talents or skills related to Chinese culture and be willing to share and interact with international students;
Interest in Chinese film and drama dubbing;
Familiar with Chinese songs and classical poetry;
Experience with Gen-AI tools, Vide-Coding, and Kahoot for designing mini-games
Capable of assisting with outings, Chinese mainland visits, and guided tour services.
Priority will be given to students with skills in Chinese knot-making and Chinese seal carving.
[SL2]
Compensation: HKD$67/hr + 5% MPF
Total working hours: Around 15 hours
Interested applicants should complete the form below by September 21. Interviews will be arranged for shortlisted candidates:

Application Form
For inquiries, please contact Miss Chen at
liyuanchen@cuhk.edu.hk

JOIN USLecture Series in Honour of Professor Jao Tsung-i: Reflection and Truth in Jao’s Scholarship, Institute of Chinese Studies, CUHK 中國文化研究所「饒宗頤教授紀念講座系列──頤學映真」 - Institute of Chinese Studies
From: Whitney Sia

ics-activities@cuhk.edu.hk

各位︰
為紀念國學大師饒宗頤教授（1917–2018）誕辰一百一十週年，香港中文大學中國文化研究所聯合香港大學饒宗頤學術館、香港浸會大學饒宗頤國學院、香港大學馮平山圖書館和學海書樓共同舉辦「饒宗頤教授紀念講座系列」。九月至十月上旬之三場「頤學映真」專題講座由中國文化研究所主辦，將於9月12日、9 月19日及10月3日在香港中文大學舉行，特邀熟悉饒教授生平與學術成就的專家學者，從宗教史、考古學、書畫藝術等不同領域與視角，回顧、探討其學術貢獻與創見。

Lecture Series in Honour of Professor Jao Tsung-i: Reflection and Truth in Jao’s Scholarship
Professor Jao Tsung-i (1917–2018), renowned for his profound erudition in both the artistic and humanistic spheres East and West, had pioneered numerous research innovations. To commemorate the 110th anniversary of his birth, the “Lecture Series in Honour of Professor Jao Tsung-i” is co-organized by the Institute of Chinese Studies at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), Jao Tsung-I Petite Ecole at the University of Hong Kong (HKU), Jao Tsung-I Academy of Sinology at Hong Kong Baptist University, Fung Ping Shan Library at HKU, and Hok Hoi Library. The three upcoming lectures, themed “Reflection and Truth in Jao’s Scholarship” and hosted by the Institute of Chinese Studies, will be held at CUHK on 12 September, 19 September, and 3 October.

To commemorate the 110th anniversary of his birth, the “Lecture Series in Honour of Professor Jao Tsung-i” is co-organized by the Institute of Chinese Studies at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), Jao Tsung-I Petite Ecole at the University of Hong Kong (HKU), Jao Tsung-I Academy of Sinology at Hong Kong Baptist University, Fung Ping Shan Library at HKU, and Hok Hoi Library. The three upcoming lectures, themed “Reflection and Truth in Jao’s Scholarship” and hosted by the Institute of Chinese Studies, will be held at CUHK on 12 September, 19 September, and 3 October.

title: Join Woo Sing Choir! Auditions Now Open for Lee Woo Sing College & CUHK Students 202627 和聲合唱團2026-27年度團員招募｜歡迎和聲書院及中大學生報名參與試音！
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/04
»
Announcements
Join Woo Sing Choir! Auditions Now Open for Lee Woo Sing College & CUHK Students 202627 和聲合唱團2026-27年度團員招募｜歡迎和聲書院及中大學生報名參與試音！ - Lee Woo Sing College
From: Fung Hoi Kuen
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
henryfung@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
和聲合唱團
現正展開2026-27年度成員招新！
我們誠摯邀請各位和聲同學及中大同學參與試音，成為和聲合唱團的一份子，令和諧之聲匯聚一堂。
和聲合唱團於2012年2月正式成立，即將迎來成立15週年。合唱團每年約有40至50名團員，是大學其中一個歷史悠久、規模最大的學生合唱團。團員每週於和聲音樂中心進行訓練，並積極參與書院高桌晚宴、迎新活動及不同典禮的演出。為展現團員一整年的學習成果，合唱團於每年下學期舉辦年度音樂會，與大學成員分享精彩的音樂演出。團員來自不同背景，包括本地生、內地生及國際生，大家各展所長，以歌手或樂手的身分一同演出，攜手組成和諧共融的音樂大家庭。
無論你是專業的歌者，又或只是對唱歌抱有熱愛之心，和聲合唱團都真誠地歡迎你，供你在活動中提升音樂水平，在台前表演，以及結交到學園中志同道合、一同熱愛歌唱的好友知音。
試音時間：
第一節：8月25日 (二) 下午1:00-2:30
第二節：9月8日 (二) 下午1:00-2:30
第三節：9月10日 (四) 晚上6:30-8:00
地點：和聲書院音樂中心（和聲書院南座地下G04室）
試音報名表格 (
需登入)
：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737334
如欲了解和聲合唱團的詳情及過往演出，歡迎瀏覽以下合唱團的網頁：
https://www.ws.cuhk.edu.hk/ws-choir/
如對和聲合唱團或試音活動有任何疑問，歡迎透過電郵聯絡我們 (
wscollege@cuhk.edu.hk
)。
誠摯期待各位成為和聲合唱團的一份子！
We are pleased to announce that the
“Woo Sing Choir (WS Choir)”
is now recruiting new members for academic year 2026-27, and we warmly invite you to audition and become part of our vibrant musical community!
Founded in February 2012, the WS Choir will soon celebrate its 15th anniversary. With around 40 to 50 members each year, it is one of the University’s longest-established and largest student choirs. The Choir rehearses weekly at the College’s Music Centre and performs at College High Table Dinners, orientation activities, ceremonies and other special occasions. Each year culminates in our Annual Concert during the second term, where members showcase their musical development and share an exciting programme of performances with the University community.
Whether you are an experienced vocalist or someone who loves to sing, the choir offers a wonderful opportunity to develop your musical skills, perform at college and university events, and build friendships with fellow music enthusiasts across Woo Sing College and CUHK.
Audition Details:
25 August (Tue), 1:00 - 2:30 PM
8 September (Tue), 1:00 - 2:30 PM
10 September (Thu), 6:30 - 8:00 PM
Venue: Music Centre, Room G04, G/F, Lee Woo Sing College
To sign up for an audition slot, please complete the registration form (sign-in required):
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737334
You may find more information about WS Choir on our official website:
https://www.ws.cuhk.edu.hk/ws-choir/
Should you have any questions, feel free to contact us at:
wscollege@cuhk.edu.hk
.
We look forward to meeting you as a member of WS Choir!
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

title: Midday Oasis: Healing Piano Concert 「午間心靈綠洲」:療癒鋼琴音樂會
bodyText:

Events / Activities
Midday Oasis: Healing Piano Concert   「午間心靈綠洲」:療癒鋼琴音樂會 - Chaplain's Office, Chung Chi College
From: Chaplain's Office
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
chaplaincy@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
「午間心靈綠洲」
為大家預備一場為心靈而寫的原創鋼琴音樂會。
鋼琴家兼作曲家李丹以樹木、日落、雨水與雲彩為靈感，獻上全屬己出的鋼琴作品。慢慢展開自然的光影與氣息：枝葉的靜、暮色的暖、雨水的洗禮、雲層的流動。每一首作品都像一封寫給內心的短箋，讓聽者在午間稍停，把外面的節奏輕輕放下。
註冊音樂治療師張映瀅在樂曲之間以言語輕柔引導專注聆聽、呼吸與哼鳴托住旋律、與之同行，使言語與音樂合而為一。
聽、息、聲，三者在同一空間裡相遇。音樂打開心靈，靜默將它接住。聲響與靜默交織之處，身心得以稍歇、重整，找回平衡。
誠邀各位於星期一下午一時三十分，蒞臨香港中文大學崇基學院禮拜堂，與我們一同進入這段為心靈而設的音樂時光。
An original piano concert written for the inner life.
Pianist-composer Dan Lee presents works entirely her own, inspired by trees, sunsets, rain and clouds, unfolds instead as light and breath: the stillness of leaves, the warmth of dusk, the cleansing of rain, the drift of clouds. Each piece is a brief letter to the heart, inviting the listener to pause at midday and set down the outer pace.
Between the pieces, registered music therapist Rebecca Cheung offers spoken guidance in mindful listening, breathing and humming, hold it and walk with music, until speech and sound become one.
Listening, breath and tone meet in the same room. Music opens the spirit; stillness receives it. Where sound and silence are woven together, body and heart rest, realign and return to balance.
You are warmly invited this Monday at 1:30 p.m. to the Chung Chi College Chapel, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, to share this time of music written for the inner life.
-------------------------------------------------------------------

The LEP is back and connects you with peers from diverse backgrounds for real conversations, meaningful cultural exchange and engaging activities along the way!
What to expect:
Practise your target language (English, Cantonese, Putonghua or more) in a natural relaxed setting

Join Social English Meet-up Club (SEMC): Meet Friends & Practise English for FREE!
Dear Students,
Want a cosy, pressure-free space to practise English, meet new friends, and join exciting workshops?
The Social English Meet-up Club (SEMC), run by the English Language Teaching Unit (ELTU) at CUHK, is officially recruiting for the 2026–2027 academic year—and you're invited!
Why Join the SEMC?
Priority Access: Be the first to grab spots for our highly popular workshops.
New ‘Read and Meet’ Initiative: Chat about interesting books, articles, and media in a completely relaxed, social setting. No exams, just great conversations!
Student Leader Initiative: Want to boost your CV? Help us plan and organise events to develop your leadership skills and earn an official ELTU Director’s Certificate.
Attendance Reward: Attend at least 80% of our gatherings this year and receive a certificate of recognition.
Best of all? Everything is completely free of charge! We welcome all CUHK students—whether local, international, undergraduate, or postgraduate.
Ready to Join Us?
It only takes a minute to sign up! Simply fill in
this online form
or scan the QR code below to become a member.
Let’s build a thriving, friendly English-speaking community together in CUHK!
Best regards,
The SEMC Team

Announcements
【Central obeisty, lifestyle intervention research】 Recruiting individuals with central obeisty aged 40-64 in the study  【中央肥胖，生活方式干預研究】中央肥胖改善計劃誠邀40-64歲合資格人士參與 - Department of Sports Science and Physical Education; Program Director: Prof. Eric Tsz-chun POON
From: HE Ye
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
heye@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學體育運動科學系誠邀中央肥胖人士參與健康管理研究！
研究目的：
中央肥胖與血糖異常、心血管疾病及其他代謝健康問題的風險增加有關。為應對這一公共健康挑戰，香港中文大學體育運動科學系正開展健康生活方式計劃，提供個人化健康支援。
參加條件：
年齡：40-64歲
平時少做運動/無規律運動習慣
中央肥胖：男性腰圍 ≥ 90 cm; 女性腰圍 ≥ 80 cm
過去三個月體重變動≤5%
現時沒有服用長期藥物
參加方法：
掃描海報二維碼或通過鏈接作網上登記【https://forms.gle/aBCMAHiFKdDK6z5L6】
研究團隊會進行初步篩選，以了解您是否符合基本參加資格
成功通過初步篩選後，預約檢查時間
前往香港中文大學汾陽體育館參加檢查
如果符合參加條件，將會被隨機分組，正式開展後續正式的健康生活方式計劃
參與地點：
香港中文大學汾陽體育館G02室
如您有任何疑問，可通過以下渠道聯絡這項研究的相關人員：
何小姐
WhatsApp: 94463265
電郵: sspe.project0716@gmail.com
[
數據安全聲明
]
所有檢測結果加密儲存，僅供研究團隊匿名分析，您可隨時要求刪除個人資料
[
歡迎邀請身邊患有糖尿病前期的親友參加
]
Study Purpose:
Central obesity is associated with an increased risk of abnormal glucose regulation, cardiovascular disease, and other metabolic health problems. To help address this growing public health concern, the Department of Sports Science and Physical Education at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is launching a Healthy Lifestyle Program that offers personalized health support for individuals with central obesity.
Recruitment criteria:
Aged between 40 and 64 years
No regular exercise habits
Central obesity: waist circumference ≥ 90 cm for men and ≥ 80 cm for women
Body weight fluctuation ≤5% in the past three months
Not taking any chronic medication
Study arrangement:
Scan QR code to register (https://forms.gle/aBCMAHiFKdDK6z5L6)
Study team wil select participants based on the register information
Arrange screening time
Arrive CUHK Kwok Sports Building for the test
If you are eligible, you will be randomly assigned to start the formal Healthy Lifestyle Intervention Program
Study Location:
Room G02, Kwok Sports Building, Department of Sports Science and Physical Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shatin
Contact Us
If you are interested and have any inquiries, please feel free to contact us:
Ms. He
WhatsApp: 94463265
Email: sspe.project0716@gmail.com
[Data safety] All data obtained during the study will be kept strictly confidential
.
[Welcome to invite friends and family who have prediabetes to participate in our study]

Central obesity is associated with an increased risk of abnormal glucose regulation, cardiovascular disease, and other metabolic health problems. Aged between 40 and 64 years
No regular exercise habits
Central obesity: waist circumference ≥ 90 cm for men and ≥ 80 cm for women
Body weight fluctuation ≤5% in the past three months
Not taking any chronic medication

Arrange screening time
Arrive CUHK Kwok Sports Building for the test
